This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Although Mary (Parker Posey) has little income, she still finds ways to spend her nights at clubs. After being arrested for throwing an illegal rave, she asks her aunt Judy (Sasha von Scherler) for bail money. Judy then finds Mary a job at her library so that Mary can repay her. Initially, Mary finds the job as a clerk boring and stifling, and prefers to get to know a street food vendor (Omar Townsend) whom she likes. However, Mary must refocus her life once she loses her job and apartment.

When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

Following a traumatic experience, former Special Forces member Dean Cage (Wesley Snipes) is trying to pick up the pieces of his fractured life. With the help of detective Amy Knight (Jacqueline Obradors), Dean tries to block out the painful wartime memories, including the death of his best friend. Everything goes awry, however, when Dean is mistaken for a rogue CIA agent. He is abducted and given a truth serum, and now he must find an antidote to the debilitating psychotropic drug.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

Bullets fly on the Atlanta freeway as armed thieves make their getaway following a bank robbery in broad daylight. Unhappy with the results, ruthless gangster Irina Vlaslov orders the men to pull off another job. One member of the team is Marcus Belmont (Anthony Mackie), a crooked cop who gets saddled with Chris Allen (Casey Affleck), his new but incorruptible police partner. As Belmont and his cohorts lay the groundwork for the heist, they come up with a devious plan to use Allen as their pawn.

Detectives Thomas Cowan (Robert De Niro) and David Fisk (Al Pacino), 30-year veterans of the NYPD, investigate the murder of a pimp. The crime resembles a case they solved many years earlier. As the body count rises, they realize they're dealing with a vigilante taking over when the police fail. The similarities between past and present crimes leads the detectives to wonder if they put the wrong man behind bars.

When Rev offers to help look after a rambunctious puppy, Rumble gets jealous of all the attention he gets. programmes.st: Bumper Ball // Vroom with a View
programmes.d: When a game of Bumper Ball gets a little too heated, the friends start competing against their own teammates! But when a stray ball knocks open the sheep pen, they'll have to learn to work together to round up the sheep...and get back to the game! // Rev and his friends receive a map in pieces, so they race up separate mountain trails, vying to be first to claim the treasure at the top. But when there's no treasure in sight at the end, Rev's parents have some advice for finding the real reward.

Rev and Avery set out to conquer a legendary endurance course, the course's challenges put their truck power to the test. But as they near the end, a call for help takes them off course-and straight into a rescue mission to save their heroes! // When Rev sees Lori working the quarry in secret, Lori asks Rev to keep it secret-she worries she isn't good enough, and dreams of working with the big quarry trucks one day. But when quarry workers need help, Rev has to convince Lori to save the day!

programmes.st: The Camping Trip // Like Father Like Son
programmes.d: Rev can't wait to take Avery camping. But when he learns they're trying a new campsite for the first time ever, he is disappointed-what if the new campsite isn't as fun...or worse...boring?! It's up to Avery to get him excited for a new adventure! // Rev wants to be just like his dad, so he and Rumble attempt Ben and Duke's usual tasks. They're disappointed when they aren't strong enough to tackle the big jobs the way Ben would, but sometimes, a little Rev magic and Rumble power are even better!

programmes.st: A Gift for Molly // Lights, Camera, Action!
programmes.d: It's Mudder's Day-everyone's favourite day of the year! The Stunt Park is filled with mud, and the whole town gets to drive through it. But Rev can't join them until he gets a gift for his Mom...and the stores are all closed for the festivities! // After Bo shows off his action-hero moves, Rev wants him to star in his film. Bu Bo freezes with stage fright as soon as Rev turns the camera on! Bo wants to be brave and come through for his friends, but how can he overcome his fear?

programmes.st: Hide & Go Bentley // T'was the Trek Before Christmas
programmes.d: Rev and Rumble teach Bentley the puppy to play Hide and Seek! At first the pup doesn't get it...but soon Bentley's hiding so well, they can't find him! Can Rumble use Bentley's instincts to help them track down their puppy pal? // A big winter storm is headed for town...and it's Christmas Eve! What if Santa can't find them through the snow? Rev and the kids round up their own toys and deliver them to all the kids in town-just in case! But can they make it through the storm?

programmes.st: Puppy Love // Fair Weather Ferry // Bumper Ball // Vroom with a View
programmes.d: Rev and Rumble are supposed to spend the day together, but Rev offers to help look after a rambunctious puppy instead, making Rumble jealous. // Rev learns that "old dogs" make great teachers, but even "old dogs" can learn new tricks from young...

Stuckey the garbage truck dreams of entering the Auto Show, so Rev and the gang clean him up for his big debut. But after saving his friends from danger, Stuckey winds up covered in mud all over again...just in time for his moment in the spotlight! // When Lori only receives two tickets to a movie premiere, her friends compete to see which one of them is her "best friend." But watching her friends compete only makes Lori feel terrible-she'd rather not go to the movie at all!

programmes.st: The Gear Up Grand Prix // Chinese New Year
programmes.d: As the Gear Up Grand Prix begins, each of the friends runs into problems and must drop out of the race. Soon, slow and steady Lori is the only one left standing! Cheered on by her friends, can Lori and Tipper find the confidence to win? // When the gang puts on a Chinese New Year play, they cast Rumble as the monster. He's a natural! programmes.st: In Deep Doo-Doo // Rev's Tree Party
programmes.d: When Rev asks to help beautify the town, he insists there's no job too tough! That is...until he finds out he'll be hauling stinky manure. Rev tries to pawn the job off, until Avery tells him the best way to get it done is to just... "doo-doo" it! // When the gang organizes a birthday party for Rev, Avery insists they keep it secret. After hiding Rev's gifts in a tree, they realize the presents are stuck up there and will need to be retrieved-all before Rev figures out what's going on!

programmes.st: Driving Miss Dottie // Follow the Bouncing Wrecking Ball

Now they'll need all the help they can get to stop the wayward ball from wrecking all of Fender Bend!

Ije meets Jaehwan after the latter gets into a car accident while being transferred to prison. Ije takes him to Haeun Hospital and taunts Jaehwan as his condition becomes critical.

Minsik accuses Sangchun of helping Ije plan Jaehwan's car accident and gives him an overdose of insulin. Ije saves Sangchun after arriving at the prison. Meanwhile, Ije continues to put pressure on Minsik to give up his position as the prison's chief medical officer.

Ije tells Sogeum of his plans to gain power through the VIPs in the prison's Special Sector. Sogeum, however, is unimpressed with Ije's intentions. Minsik and Ije each attempt to get the list of investors before the other does.

Minsik tries to use Sangchun to cut off Ije's hand, but Ije persuades Sangchun, saying that he will help Sangchun meet his daughter. Meanwhile, Sogeum finds out that Ije injected a drug into Bit before he disappeared.
Ije plans to get Seokwoo released by making it seem like he has Wilson's disease. Meanwhile, Uisik goes to Jeonghui, suspecting collusion between her and Ije.
Ije, Hyesu, Sangchun, and Jeonghui begin to plan a way to retaliate against Minsik. Minsik tells Jaejun that Ije will be investigated and sets a trap to hunt him down.

Having discovered Seoyeong's secret, Seonu works out a way to get her revenge. Seongjae is still on the streets and Seoyeong tries to cheer up Jiseon whilst Hojeong is living happily as the new bride.

Seongjae's home and things are still heated between Jiseon and Somi. Somi won't give up her right as a mother. Meanwhile things are also continuing to get heated between Lawyers Jeong and Lee... But a coincidental run in between Jiseon and Seonu at the law firm makes everything spiral out of control. Just as Ujae is about to forgive Seoyeong and start again, Seonu drops the bombshell on the family.

Seoyeong plans to finalize her breakup with Ujae and goes out to start her own practice. The family is breaking apart and everything's in chaos with the continuing shocks. In the end Ujae finally tells Seoyeong what he knew.

Seoyeong's left home and everyone's looking for her. She gets help and is taken care of by Yeonhui for the time being. Meanwhile, everyone including Seoyeong's family finds out about what's happened and they're all in despair…

Seoyeong meets her dad for the first time in 3 years. But she's still as cold and unforgiving to him as ever. Meanwhile, Samjae gets depressed from the meeting and Seoyeong tries to begin her life over.

Ujae meets Samjae and Sangu and finally begins to understand... But the greatest thing he learns is that just because he forgives Seoyeong and understands her, it doesn't mean she'll find the love she once had for him again... Perhaps it's all too late now...

Hwon learns from Hong Gyu-tae that Princess Minhwa was involved in the death of the Crown Princess. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, who remains by Hwon's side, is tormented by her inability to offer him any comfort. Having reached a final decision, Hwon goes to confront the Grand Queen Dowager.

On her way to warn Hwon of an impending rebellion, Bogyeong witnesses him sharing a tender moment with Yeonwoo. Driven by jealousy and fear, Bogyeong summons Kwon, the former head shaman of Seongsucheong, and orders her to place a dark curse upon Yeonwoo.

As Hwon heads toward the Royal Ancestral Shrine, he is surrounded by Yoon Daehyeong's private soldiers. Leading the rebel forces, Yangmyung raises his sword against Hwon, while Yoon Daehyeong coldly orders that the king be executed. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, fleeing to a hideout with Hong Gyu-tae, is seized by a deep and ominous premonition.

Raon disguises herself as a man named Samnom and does all kinds of work to earn money, pay off the debts and find her mother. One day, she is kidnapped by the moneylenders, and they sell her to the Office of Eunuch Attendants to get their money back. She happens to work as a eunuch when she is a woman.

To become the official eunuch, the trainees have to pass three exams which are the physical fitness, the written exam and the character test. They will be kicked out of the palace once they fail at least one of them. In order to escape, Raon tries to fail, however, Yeong intentionally helps Raon so that she cannot escape from the palace.

The King personally orders Raon to deliver his response of Consort Park's letter, and it turns out to be a secret letter written with apple vinegar. Meanwhile, Yeong realizes that the King has been doing nothing just to protect his people. In order to share his burden, Yeong suggests the King to command him to take the throne in the interim.
Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets.

In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

Superstar rap mogul C-Note (Antwan "Big Boi" Patton) wants to join the Carolina Pines Golf & Country Club, but faces stiff opposition from the establishment's snooty members. C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 1
programmes.d: 15-year-old Eli Shane is a regular kid except for one thing: he comes from a long line of Shanes, each who has journied from the surface to protect Slugterra and the slugs that make the world special.

programmes.st: The World Beneath Our Feet Pt 2
programmes.d: Now its Eli's turn to be Slugterra's next Shane, whether he's ready or not! Unfortunately, the slugslinging tournament he enters to prove that he's ready, pretty quickly shows that he's not!

After the Shane hideout is ransacked, the gang trades in one of Eli's prized slugs for new gear. When Eli has second thoughts they go back to get it, only to learn that it's been sold to Dr. Blakk, along with hundreds of others to be transformed into feral Ghoul Slugs. Eli refuses to let his slug or any other get ghouled, so the team breaks in to Blakk's fortress to free them. While inside, they learn of Blakk's plan to conquer Slugterra.
When the punks in the Hooligang cruise into Quiet Lawn Cavern, they think no one there's got the guts to stand up to them so they trash the place.
The gang signs up for a weekend camp that promises to teach your slugs tons of new moves - without lifting a finger!

The Slug Run is the ultimate, off-road, no-holds-barred, cross-cavern Mecha Beast race. Unfortunately, the only thing lower than the odds of beating the three-time champ who's now racing for Dr. Blakk are the odds of Eli making it to the finish line in one piece!
When even Kord can't find a way to fix what's wrong with the new upgrades to the Shane Gang's Mecha Beasts, it's time to go to the source: the wondrous Mecha Forge!
Eli doesn't believe in ghosts - until he enters Deadweed cavern! But it turns out Eli's first instinct was right.
A short cut takes the Shane Gang through the territory of the Shadow Clan - and try as they might not to, they are discovered and captured by the mysterious creatures.
Pronto is thrown in jail on trumped-up charges by a corrupt judge, and the only chance to break him out is Eli making a one-in-a-million trick shot.

Long thought to be merely a legend, an Enigmo Slug has finally been spotted. The bidding is high for this rarest of all slugs, and so is the competition to be the first grab it! Eli and the gang actually beat Slugterra's most vicious slug hunter to the prize-only to find that the hunter is now hunting them!
After a wild ride on the mysterious Flumes - the Underriver that runs beneath all of Slugterra - the Shane gang find themselves dropped into a sea cavern.
A fun trip to the mall cavern turns un-deadly when the place is over run by the zombie-like victims of the Zombus slug.
The four members of the Shane Gang think they've found the fifth in Twist, a street-smart kid who volunteers his help when the gang needs it most on a mission gone wrong.

On a trip to Port Mobius, Sonic, Manic and Sonia are told that ships are sinking due to the Mobian sea-beast.

programmes.st: Who Do You Think You Are
programmes.d: Rumor has it that Queen Aleena's journals are buried in the city of Tashistan. Sonic and his siblings search the city for the scrolls.
While lost in the wastelands of Mobius, Sonic, Manic and Sonia stumble upon an oasis called Lake Valley Resort.
Sonia is invited to a debutante ball, but before she can be officially announced to society, she and her brothers, Manic and Sonic have an important mission.
Robotnik organizes a track meet to lure Sonic into a trap.

programmes.st: A Hedgehog's Home Is Her Castle
programmes.d: The Hedgehogs find out that Sonia has inherited a castle. She basks in the idea of having a castle for headquarters.
The Hedgehogs steal historical artifacts of Mobuis from Robotnik before he can pawn them off at an auction.
A group of Freedom Fighters is obliterated by a swarm of metallic fly-bots. When Manic goes looking for the insects, he is stung with serum.
A speed enhancing fluid deemed Sonic Tonic is created by Robotnik to make him as fast as Sonic so that he may finally catch him.
Momma escapes again from the Mobius Home for Really Bizarre People, disowns Robotnik for failing to capture Sonic, then with the help of an obscure Mobius law, adopts Sonic!

When S and G rocket to outerspace to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars.
When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck.

Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

Brandon Quark, an evil half-man, half-duck genius challenges, then teams up with Robotnik to capture Sonic. But Sonic knows their weakness, and pits the Badnik geniuses against one another, and sets himself free.

When Wes Weasley returns to the Fortress, Coconuts tricks Robotnik into signing an IOU so he can buy thousands of Mobiums worth of magic tricks to use on Sonic. In the end, Sonic goes free, and Robotnik is forced to pay Wes the massive IOU debt.

Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Chuckie and Kimi start at Dayscare and discover a mystery surrounding a staircase post. Later, the Rugrats face off with the McNultys in a playful turf rivalry inspired by West Side Story.

programmes.st: Changes For Chuckie/The Magic Show/A LuLu Of A Time
programmes.d: With Kira and Kimi moving in, Chuckie feels his life is changing forever. Later, the Rugrats think they’ve found real magic backstage at a show, and Lulu babysits them during a visit to a retirement community.

Competing in the Mayor's fitness test is going to be no picnic for Doug who is ironically out of shape. A hot-shot movie director is talent hunting in Bluffington and everyone is sure they will be chosen, especially Judy.

The Beets concert is sold out, but Doug finagles two tickets out of his sister.  He and Skeeter set out on an incredible adventure where they end up as emergency Beets roadies. Doug has a cavity and must go to the dentist.

programmes.st: Smile and Say Oblina/The Great Wave
programmes.d: Even monsters get the blues, which Oblina proves when she develops her first crush.  Life is no day at the beach for Ickis as his self-esteem hits a rip tide when he is chosen to be a contestant in the Annual Riding of the Great Wave Competition.

programmes.st: Cold Hard Toenails/Attack of the Blobs
programmes.d: Ickis becomes rich when he discovers an unending supply of toenails, but soon discovers money doesn't make the monster.  Oblina becomes a baby-sitter and gets a job minding a blob only a mother could love.

programmes.st: Tree of Hearts / Dag for Night
programmes.d: When Treeflower reenters Norbert's life he expects their love to blossom once more.  However, Norb didn't count on the lure that large trucks have for beaver women and he loses Treeflower to Dag's archenemy: Truckee the truck driving shrew.

programmes.st: Un-Barry-ble / Another One Bites the Musk
programmes.d: When Barry the Bear decides to revive his singing career, he embarks on a search for The Groove. Daggett and Norbert learn how to mark territory with their scent glands.

Darwin brings Eliza to a chimpanzee compound.  When Eliza is not being subservient to the hierarchy, Darwin gets in hot water with the leader. Only after a threatening fire starts does Eliza realize the necessary hierarchy for jungle survival.

Eliza pulls the wrong lever and catapults the commvee to the bottom of the deeper waters of Australia!  She is soon forced to don scuba gear and enlist the help of an army of dugongs in order to rescue her dad!
Debbie discovers Eliza talking to dingoes and threatens to tell her parents. Eliza is afraid of being shipped back to the United States as a science experiment, seeks help from nearby Aborigines.

It's soccer season and Phil is soccer-crazy. Lil joins the team and becomes an instant success. So much that Phil starts to resent her. Lil must choose between walking away from a passion and respecting her only brother's feelings.
Tommy and the gang decide to put together a boxcar to compete in the upcoming derby. Can they make it to the finals, or will Angelica spoil their plans by entering her own car in the race?
Chuckie is dreading Christmas so to liven things up, he steals a tree. Meanwhile, Kira and Kimi are stuck at the airport, and Tommy and Dil try to write a Chanukah song.

Susie is irritated that Angelica doesn't think much about the future. While Angelica is worrying about getting a navel piercing, Susie tries to get a college scholarship. When they're left behind on a school trip, who will get them back home safely?
When Grandpa Lou's buddy Red challenges the kids to work his dude ranch, Tommy jumps at the chance to prove himself, and drags the rest of the Rats along with him.
The Palm Woods school is having it's annual Prom and Carlos, James, Logan and Kendall are all determined to win the prom king title, doing whatever it takes to win.
A teen magazine runs a “Win a Date with BTR” contest, and the 4 lucky winning girls – each with their own baggage – give the guys serious dating drama.

Lucy, an 18-year-old rocker chick moves into the Palm Woods and she immediately blows the BTR guys away by how cool she is. Carlos and James are desperate to date Lucy, while Kendall tries to prove that BTR can rock too.
BTR refuses to record their second album after Gustavo is too hard on them, and the strike pits the determined band against their stubborn producer in a battle of wills.
While Gustavo struggles to write the band's next hit song, the guys try to cheer up Kendall, who is heartbroken after his break-up with Jo.
Hawk has returned and has a new evil plan to take down Big Time Rush. He plans on stealing BTR's new tracks for their second album and releasing them himself.

Secrets are being kept at the Palm Woods. Kendall and Camille are spending a lot of time together making Logan suspicious. James reveals he never told Carlos that Heather Fox, Carlos' camp crush, liked him.
Drake enters a local talent show. When a rival entry in the talent show steals Drake's song at the last minute, he enlists the help of Josh to perform a Blues Brothers routine.
Josh gets a traffic ticket right after getting his Driver's License. Drake pays the fine so Josh doesn't have to tell their Dad, in exchange for Josh's chauffer services.
A seemingly innocuous little girl from Josh's Campfire Kid's troop has an obsessive crush on Drake and his music. As she gets increasingly intrusive, Drake, regrettably, blows up at her.
Drake is unable to break up with his inappropriately laughing girlfriend because she is the daughter of his teacher who has threatened him with summer school.
Drake and Josh become pawns in a plot to sell stolen Gary Coleman grills, and are put in jail when they are falsely accused by the FBI of masterminding the operation.
Josh befriends Drake's doppelganger, a classmate named Drew, and Drake becomes jealous, fearing that Josh is trying to replace him.
When Mr. Madigan decides to retire, he leaves the company to True.
After accidentally placing Mrs. Madigan's wedding ring in a dress pocket and sending the dress to Paris, True and Lulu use planes, trains, and automobiles to get to the ring before Max finds out.
Kenan and Kel's lives are disrupted when Kenan's father gets a new job and the Rockmores are forced to move to Pummis, Montana.

There's a big comic book convention in town and Kenan and Kel are dying to go.  Too bad Kenan has to train Rigby's new employee, Sharla, that day.  The guys decide to go anyway and things go downhill from there.
Kenan and Kel manage to score dates with two lovely young ladies, but they end up with their heads stuck in a fence.
The Rockmores get a brand new television set.  Kel breaks the new TV that Chris was planning on raffling off at Rigby's, so Kenan pulls the old switcheroo.
There's a new girl in school, Becky.  Kel thinks he's head-over-heels in love with her.  Kenan thinks she's a witch and is determined to prove it.

The boys have the fight of all fights and decide to move out. James ends up squatting in a cool retiree’s apartment, Logan moves into a place right by the water, Carlos builds a cardboard house, and Kendall must fix things.

Big Time Rush has just dropped their second album and the guys get interviewed on an entertainment tonight-type program where they answer revealing questions about their life inside and outside of Big Time Rush.

It's BTR's final stop on their world tour and we go behind the scenes and see all the craziness that happens backstage. Mixing in real concert footage, we see the guys prepare for the show and deal with backstage drama.

The boys return from their world tour and are now famous at the Palm Woods, but they just want to get settled and focus on girls. Griffin tries to bribe Carlos to pick his favorite song for the boys’ upcoming radio interview.
When Drake is falsely accused of playing a practical joke on one of his teachers and threatened with suspension, he and Josh plead their case before the Honor Council.
Drake and Josh are left in charge for the weekend and quickly exhaust their funds and turn the house into a bed and breakfast as a source of income.

In this edgy and darkly humorous Western, a mysterious young woman rides into the lawless town of Redemption to settle an old score that has haunted her since childhood. She becomes swept up in a deadly quick-draw tournament. Rated: R

The Andromeda is haunted by a mysterious creature that comes aboard during a solar storm.

programmes.st: And Your Heart Will Fly Away
programmes.d: When a long lost love returns, Tyr disappears from the ship to protect her from an assassin.
Set in an alternate universe where Dylan died and Gaheris Rhade is trying to reform the Commonwealth.
The group that attacked the Andromeda during the first Commonwealth charter signing returns to wreak more havoc.
Trance runs through a number of different scenarios, trying to find one in which her crewmates don't die.
A "more powerful" Andromeda ship explodes due to likely sabotage, forcing Dylan's crew to save them.
Beka endangers both her crew and an entire planet when a former love shows up.

programmes.st: What Happens to a Rev Deferred?
programmes.d: The Andromeda receives a cry for help from Rev Bam.
After a Commonwealth planet is attacked by Pyrian pyroformers, Dylan is forced to fight to protect the new planet.
Dylan hears voices beckoning him to a planet of "fire and ice," so he pursues, even though it means crossing hostile Nietzschean-controlled space.
While caught in a battle between two Nietzschean prides, the crew captures a hostile who claims that his pride possesses a map of the slipstream.
A wrong turn after exiting a slipstream sends the Andromeda into the Prolon system. They rescue an escape pod from certain disaster, but the pride wants it back.
The crew seeks a lost colony of Nietzscheans and discovers another crew that has been secretly helping them.

programmes.st: Day of Judgement, Day of Wrath
programmes.d: The crew installs a new AI in a new Commonwealth battleship, and naturally, things don't go as they should.

programmes.st: Shadows Cast by a Final Salute

programmes.st: Answers Given to Questions Never Asked
programmes.d: A message from a collector sends Dylan on a quest to rescue a hostage and find the remains of the Commonwealth fleet.
Citizen Eight tries to remove Dylan from command of Andromeda.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Warrior of Wind
programmes.d: When the battle between Wamuu and Joseph comes to a head, the surprising confessions aren’t far behind. Now the final hour has come for Lisa Lisa and Kars—a fighter very different from his fellow Pillar Men.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Ties that Bind JoJo
programmes.d: With Lisa Lisa’s life on the line, Joseph must deceive the deceiver. Joining Joseph, Stroheim and Speedwagon arrive at the battlefield, where a family tragedy threatens to doom the world to a hopeless future.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Birth of a Superbeing
programmes.d: Having seized the Red Stone and the mask, Kars has become the Ultimate Being. Now the seemingly invincible entity has his sights solely on Joseph who, fleeing, has one final trick up his sleeve.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Ascendant One
programmes.d: Deep within a volcano’s molten lava, Kars contemplates a comeback. But with the Red Stone’s power unleashed, both warriors are launched into the stratosphere of the unknown.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
programmes.st: The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
programmes.d: Japan, 1987. Jotaro Kujo, a descendant of the Joestar family, is in prison and claims he is being possessed by an evil spirit. His grandfather, Joseph Joestar, immediately departs for Japan, where he must reveal the family's terrible secret.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Who Will Be the Judge!?
programmes.d: Jotaro returns to his normal life while keeping his "Stand" power a secret. But on the way to school one day he meets a new transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin and sustains a strange injury.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Curse of DIO
programmes.d: Jotaro defeats Kakyoin with his Stand power, but as he attempts to glean information from his adversary about DIO, Joseph notices a sinister connection.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Tower of Grey
programmes.d: The Joestars must defeat DIO within 50 days or Holly's life is forfeit. With no time to lose, they head for Egypt where DIO is thought to be hiding but end up encountering a new threat along the way.

Jotaro and his comrades are attacked by Polnareff, an assassin with a Stand called "Silver Chariot" that is capable of lightning-fast swordplay. It falls to Avdol to face down the threat using "Magician's Red."

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Dark Blue Moon
programmes.d: Jotaro welcomes a new member to the team and the group leaves for Singapore by ship. Along the way, a young stowaway is found and Jotaro comes under attack, but is the child the source of this latest evil?
Jotaro’s group is rescued when they spot a giant cargo ship, but they soon find that the only occupant is a strange orangutan. Curious, they begin to explore the ship and solve its mysteries.
Jotaro and his companions finally make it to a hotel in Singapore, but soon Polnareff falls into a trap set by a dangerous and brutal enemy.

Joseph uses his Stand to generate a spirit message from a TV, only to receive a warning claiming that Kakyoin is a traitor. Meanwhile, Jotaro, Ann and Kakyoin are out exploring Singapore when Kakyoin begins acting strangely.
The Joestars' group arrives in India, where Polnareff is attacked by a Stand only visible through a mirror. As terrifying as it is, the Stand could also be related to his sister's murder.
As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot's brutal attacks.
Saitama tags along to an emergency meeting of Class S heroes and discovers that a seer has foretold a serious danger threatening the Earth.
As a colossal spaceship floats in the skies above City A, a member of its monstrous crew battles on the ground against a group of S-Class heroes.
The inconceivably powerful Lord Boros has traveled untold distances in search of someone who can cure his boredom: Saitama!
Kaname asks Yuki to be his lover. The Night Class guards begin accompanying her everywhere, and Yuki cannot hide her embarrassment. Why does Kaname go to such great lengths to protect Yuki?
Senri returns to the Academy, but upon having a confidential talk with Ichiru, he becomes noticeably different from before.
Yuki wakes up a vampire, and her memory of her childhood returns. She now remembers her father, her mother, and her brother.
Yuki now understands who she really is. Worried about Zero, she sneaks out of her room to find him. Zero cannot accept Yuki’s new self, and he points the Bloody Rose gun at her.
Mello busts into SPK headquarters to retrieve a photograph of himself to make sure he won't be killed by Kira.
Near contacts the Japanese task force and determines that Kira is among their members.
Star newscaster Kiyomi Takada becomes Kira's spokesperson to the world.
Light pretends to investigate Kiyomi.
Aizawa figures out what's going on and tells Near, who already knows about the notes.
Light gives Kiyomi the order to finish off Near.
Ibara is critically injured after getting caught in a blast caused by the 1st Division’s tank.
While heading to the hospital, Ibara and her team run into Cleanup Crew members Kanon and Shion Ozu, otherwise known as the Ozu Sisters.
Haruto informs the group that a massive and lethal Zone is approaching the Planet.
The Coppelion set their escape plan into motion by dividing into two teams, with the Diversion Team led by Ibara.
The Diversion Team find themselves in serious trouble when the 1st Division brings out their secret weapon, the Iron Spider.

programmes.st: Paul Martin and Raj Bisram, Day 4

programmes.st: The Case Of The Cross-Dressing Carp

The CSI team investigates the death of a wealthy man in a hip nightclub and the inadvertent shooting of a young boy during a robbery.

After a young woman and a prominent judge are murdered, the CSI team works to discover the connection between the two crimes.

programmes.d: The TARDIS lands on the old Dalek homeworld of Skaro.

programmes.st: Destiny of the Daleks: Part Two
programmes.d: Romana is captured and interrogated by the Daleks whilst the Doctor meets the Movellans.

programmes.st: Destiny of the Daleks: Part Three
programmes.d: Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor.

programmes.st: Destiny of the Daleks: Part Four
programmes.d: The Doctor discovers that the Daleks need Davros to break the stalemate in their war with the Movellans.
While on holiday in Paris, the Doctor and Romana experience a time distortion.
Scarlioni is planning to steal the Mona Lisa. Yet he has six in his cellar - all genuine.
Count Scarlioni is really Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth.
Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction.
While under the influence of the evil Mara, Tegan redirects the Tardis to the Mara's former home planet.
The Doctor begins to unravel the legend of the Little Mind's Eye crystal; Tegan remains under the Mara's control as it attempts to regain its hold over the planet Manussa.
Chela takes the Doctor's fears seriously and tells him the snake dancer Dojjen can aid him in defeating the Mara.
The Doctor and the original snake dancer Dojjen work to rid the planet of the malign Mara once and for all, but it has the whole of Manussa in its psychic grip now.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part One
programmes.d: The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Two
programmes.d: The Doctor escapes Adrasta by going into the mine, but there's something lurking inside.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Three
programmes.d: The Doctor makes contact with the creature and realizes that all is not as it seems.

programmes.st: The Creature From the Pit: Part Four
programmes.d: The truth of Adrasta's scheme is revealed, but a terrible retribution is already in motion.
(1/4) A hyperspace accident results in two ships fusing together and releasing a deadly menace.
(2/4) The Doctor and Romana discover that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.
(3/4) The Mandrels have escaped from the Eden projection and are attacking the passengers.
(4/4) Unless the Doctor and Romana act quickly, the villains will escape justice.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part One
programmes.d: With the TARDIS disabled, the Doctor is powerless to act when Romana is kidnapped.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Two
programmes.d: The Doctor attempts to repair the TARDIS so that he can come to Romana's rescue.

programmes.st: The Horns of Nimon: Part Three
programmes.d: The Doctor and Romana suspect that the Nimon are a small part of a large invasion.
A Pekingese who refuses to eat or drink; a Chihuahua who bites people; two chow mixes who share a home but won't play nice with each other.
A woman's French bulldog exhibits people aggression that started for no apparent reason when he turned two years old.

Life coach and fitness trainer Jillian Michaels can whip contestants on the "Biggest Loser" television series into shape, but she's at a loss when it comes to her dog; escape artist dog; dog dislikes brooms and windshield wipers.
Two German shepherds who get along fine at home, but are at each other's throats when at daycare; a miniature schnauzer that barks when her owner's grandchildren visit.
A great Dane bites her owner; a bearded collie with dog aggression; a mouthy French mastiff.
A Weimaraner is aggressive towards anyone who turns on one of the motorized bikes used to deliver the mail; an aggressive Shar-Pei; an Australian red cattle dog who barks incessantly.
Two Chihuahuas who fight whenever they are in the same room; a dog who attempts to prevent his owner's boyfriend from leaving the house; a dog who is obsessed with moving water.
Cesar revisits some of his toughest cases and explores the history or misunderstood dog breeds to dispel myths about aggression.
A Maltese hates being on his leash; an American Eskimo barks and circles strangers who enter the house; a Nova Scotia duck tolling retriever with a fear of pools.
Cesar helps a pregnant Ashlee Simpson-Wentz's English bulldog with his aggression issues before the baby arrives; a retriever with food aggression.
An aggressive sheepdog/collie mix needs extra attention, so Cesar brings him to the Dog Psychology Center; a St. Bernard with a fear of stairs.
Cesar's English adventure ends with an aggressive Klee Kai, a collie mix that hates walks, and a hyper Labrador.
A Chihuahua mix with aggression issues; a Pomeranian with severe separation anxiety; an Aussie/Shar Pei mix who runs away when his owner coughs.
Two wolf hybrids with aggression issues; an aggressive Chihuahua.
A basset hound is afraid of her owner's husband; a blue heeler mix with unique bedtime rituals.
A vicious Chihuahua frightens the pit bulls at the rescue center where he lives.
A Wheaten terrier puppy bites when playing; a Jack Russell terrier jumps when the garbage disposal runs and lunges at the dishwasher; a Lab fears shiny floors.
Step right up and join the fiesta! Dora and Boots are trying to win the grand prize—the Big Piñata! They need to collect 10 yellow tickets by playing carnival games and rides.
Nothing can stop Dora and Boots; they will not fail! Their job is to deliver the mail! Dora and Boots are mail carriers, and they need to deliver all the letters, even one to Swiper the Fox!

Map finds a red cape and becomes a superhero for the day. He can jump, he can fly, he can blow clouds away with a single, super breath! He's Super Map! When Dora's mommy calls her home, Dora and Boots need to get home fast.
Dora has tried and tried, but she's never been able to climb all the way across the monkey bars. Dora and Boots set off for Play Park so Dora can give it another try.
C'mon and join the musical parade! Dora and Boots are leading a parade over the Piano Bridge and through the Swinging Gate to free the instruments that were locked up by the evil Señor Shhh!
Dora and her friends are super good at hiding, especially Señor Tucán when he hides in the Rain Forest. If we can find all 8 friends, Señor Tucán promises to introduce us to his new baby toucans.

Finding the animals—that's a good trick! If you see an animal, aim and say, "Click!" Dora the photographer and her assistant, Boots, set off with a new camera to take pictures of wild animals for a photo contest.
Dora and Boots are on the hunt for cascarones—special eggs with confetti and prizes inside.

Dora and Boots are Super Spies on a top-secret mission: they have to stop Swiper from swiping Isa's cupcakes. Spy gadgets—everything from rocket sneakers to a Swiper detector—will help them find their way.
Boots is visiting Dora's classroom when they notice that the school pet, a cute and cuddly hamster named Mimo, is missing from his cage. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to rescue him!
"Happy Birthday to you," plays the Birthday Balloon as it floats by high in the sky. There's going to be a birthday party—but whose birthday is it?

When Dora and Boots color in a picture of Mami Duck and her eggs, their coloring book magically comes to life, and the eggs start to hatch. Suddenly, the wind blows one of Mami Duck's eggs away. Oh no!
Mary had a Little Lamb, but now Little Lamb is lost.  Dora and Boots jump into a big book of Nursery Rhymes to bring Little Lamb back to her best friend, Mary.

Calling all trucks!  Boots sure loves trucks.  When Ice Cream Truck gets stuck in the muck at Play Park, Dora and Boots are off to the rescue.  Boots uses his truck phone to call his other truck friends for help along the way.
What are we going to do?  Cockledoodledoo!  Dora and Boots help their friend, Red Rooster, get to the Highest Hill so he can wake up the Sun.  Along the way we practice making lots of noise.
Dora and Boots meet Roberto, a very cool robot with a tool belt, flashing lights, stretching powers, and super strength. But Roberto's lost!

Benny the Bull finds a magic wand and turns himself into a potato by mistake. Oh no! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring their potato friend back to the Young Wizard so that he can change Benny back into a bull again.

Blast into outer space as Dora and Boots set off to bring stranded space creatures back home to the Purple Planet. Take a wild ride on a rocketship, travel through the Milky Way, and catch a ride on a comet.

Where do toys go when they're lost? To the Lost City! But the Lost City is really hard to find. Dora and Boots are on an educational, Indiana Jones-like adventure as they race through the Number Pyramid and the Jumbled Jungle.
Meet Diego, Dora's super cool cousin. Diego works at the Animal Rescue Center. He can make animal noises and talk to wild animals!

Woof!  Woof!  Dora and Boots have a new video game called "Save the Puppies."  A mean dogcatcher has locked up all the puppies in the Doggie Cages.  To save them, Dora and Boots super jump into the video game.

Dora and Boots read a fairy tale about a young kinkajou—a cute and cuddly forest creature—who is destined to be king. But the kinkajou loses his crown because he doesn't know the magic words, "por favor."

Dora, Boots and Diego need to bring a giant baby dinosaur home to his mommy at Dino Island.  It's a prehistoric adventure through a land of dinosaurs.  Tiptoe past a T-Rex, meet a Compsagnathus - the world's smallest dinosaur.
Today, Boots gets to do anything he wants, because it's his special day! Un día especial. Boots' favorite thing in the whole world is to visit his daddy at work.

Rescue Truck arrives at Diego's Animal Center to deliver a cute, little animal that's really lost: a penguin!  It's up to Dora, Boots and Diego to bring Ping³ino all the way back home to the South Pole.
Dora's cousin Daisy is playing in a big soccer game that's showing on TV. But Daisy's team is short a player. Daisy appeals to Dora to come play on her team and save the game. Run, Dora, run!
It's Halloween, and Dora and Boots are out trick-or-treating when a cute monster surprises them. Dora and Boots help hurry it home before the clock strikes 12.
What comes after "The End"? Dora and Boots are finishing a fairy tale and reach the end of the story. They wonder what happens next.

Oh no! Three of our friends are in trouble. Baby Jaguar is stuck in a tree, Isa is stuck in a big sand hole, and Benny is stuck in his balloon on top of the Gooey Geyser. Who do we have to rescue first?
It's bedtime, and Dora and Boots are having a sleepover. Dora has her teddy bear, Osito, but Boots can't find his cuddly dinosaur. Oh no! His dinosaur must have fallen out of his bag at Play Park.
Bawk! It's fiesta time! Dora and Boots are invited to the Big Red Chicken's Super Silly Fiesta! There will be silly snacks, silly games, silly hats, and even silly dancing. But, oh no!
Uh oh! Boots has a hole—un hoyo—in his boot! But Dora knows what to do. They can go to the Super Duper Fix-It Machine to fix it right up!
Boots loves baseball. He loves to run and catch and throw, but so far he's never gotten a hit. Boots is determined to get his first hit. Dora and Boots have a big baseball game today.

Happy Best Friends Day! Today's a special day for best friends to play together. Boots and Dora decide to meet for a picnic to celebrate. Boots is bringing chocolate; Dora is bringing yummy strawberries.
Dr. Mike’s patients begin dying mysteriously.
Brian suffers a crisis of faith when the Rev. Johnson is stricken with progressive blindness at Christmas time, despite the healing efforts of Dr. Mike.
When Sully opposes the building of a dam, he finds himself on the other side of the law and behind bars.
Dr. Mike's revered Uncle Theodore shocks her and Sully when he criticizes their parenting skills and offers to take Brian to Boston.
Dr. Mike sees that the marriage of Kid Cole and Sister Ruth is unraveling for no apparent reason.
Dr. Mike reminisces about her tumultuous career – the successes and the failures -- since living in Colorado Springs.

programmes.st: A HOUSE DIVIDED, PART 1 (aka Between Friends, Pt. 1)
programmes.d: Sully’s best friend, Daniel Simon, falls in love with Dr. Mike.

programmes.st: A HOUSE DIVIDED, PART 2 (aka Between Friends, Pt. 2)
programmes.d: Sully’s best friend, Daniel Simon, falls in love with Dr. Mike.
Dr. Mike, Brian and Katie are taken hostage by bank robbers.
Dr. Quinn and the townspeople excitedly welcome poet Walt Whitman to Colorado Springs until rumors about his personal life begin to circulate.
Horace attempts suicide after receiving the official divorce document from Myra.
Dr. Mike is scandalized by the new liberated lifestyle her sister has adopted as a suffragette.
Sully and Brian forge a true father-son bond.
The government puts a price on Sully’s head when he organizes an escape for Cloud Dancing that results in a deadly massacre.
Everyone but Michaela assumes that Sully is dead when he disappears after a fight with his nemesis, Sgt. O’Connor.
Sully struggles to survive in the wilderness as Dr. Mike desperately searches for him.
Dr. Mike hides Sully to protect him from the army who wanted to arrest him but believe he is dead.
Alexis warns Blake about Sean's true identity. Concerned for his family's safety, Blake and Dex go to Natumbre to uncover Sean's mysterious scheme involving the Vitron oil deal.
Following the explosion in Natumbre, Blake is accused of dealing in illegal arms; Alexis uncovers proof that Sean paid Jesse to return to Denver so he could persuade Karen to keep Adam's baby.

Dana tries desperately to convince Adam how much she wants their son. She proposes that if they were a loving couple again, the judge would find in their favor. Still hurting from her outburst in court, Adam is cold to her pleas.
Adam is absolved of suspicion in the kidnapping of his son when Leslie calls him to say that Sean has taken the baby and is holding her captive. Adam and Steven hurry to the desolate mountain cabin.

Following Sean's death, Alexis is comforted by Dex's solace and friendship, as the two renew their passionate love for each other; Jeff and Sammy Jo are horrified to find her diary and a dead body in the water.

Sammy Jo and Jeff are relieved when they discover the body found floating in the lake is not Krystle; Blake's fears increase when Krystle's car is found and the man arrested for stealing it is a convicted murderer.
Enjoying his time with Krystle in Dayton, Blake remains perplexed by the case of her memory lapses.

Blake gives Jeff one-third controlling interest in Denver-Carrington, postponing Adam's plans to gain sole control of the company; Blake and Krystle meet with Dr. Hampton to begin tests, while Blake tells her the true reason for her severe headaches.
Suspecting her accountant has worked with Sean to ruin Colbyco, Alexis faces the reality she may lose her empire; receiving bad news from her doctor, Krystle asks Fallon to gather the family.

Surrounded by those she loves, Krystle resolves to live; Fallon takes the picture of Blake and the dead man to the morgue, unaware she is being watched; Accusing Blake of killing him twenty-five years ago, Alexis vows to avenge his death.

Interpreting Alexis' vendetta against Blake as a love/hate relationship, Dex tells Alexis he is through being taken for granted by her; Sammy suspects Virginia may not be as naive as she wants people to think.

Krystle agrees to have her operation, but only after Blake signs her divorce papers and living will, to be enacted if the surgery is not a success; Fallon is haunted by recurring dreams of Roger Grimes.

Krystle's operation is unsuccessful and she slips into a coma. Told she will probably never recover, a grieving Blake returns to Denver; Sammy Jo is attacked by an unknown assailant; Dex discovers Joanna is a link to Alexis' controller, Heath.
Fearing that his darkest secret will be revealed because of the search for Roger Grimes's murderer, Blake vows to take the rap to put an end to the investigation; Dex and Sable both go after Heath.

Sammy Jo recognizes Gibson as the man Krystle saw in her nightmares, and Blake vows to protect his family secret with his life; Adam discovers Virginia's secret past; Blake entrusts Dex with documents relating to their family's secret.
Alexis hires a mercenary to get her ships back; Adam and Jeff exchange blows after he accuses Adam of being disloyal to Blake; Dex begins to doubt Alexis can ever offer him the kind of love he needs.

Sable tries to convince Blake she is on his side. Dex is attracted by her loyalty; Sammy Jo's interest in Tanner McBride intensifies; Dex attacks Adam after learning he took advantage of Virginia; Joanna becomes jealous of Sable's interest in Dex.
A Department of Justice agent is compromised in the press and then vanishes before she can be brought in.
A serial killer, released from prison, disappears; someone is stalking Antonio.
Jess dreams about people who have disappeared and is teamed with an FBI agent to find a Senator's missing fiancée.
Brooke and Jess investigate the disappearance of an FBI cadet.
Jess battles insomnia; pressure builds to find a serial killer's next victim before time runs out.
Cassie returns to the dating world and her determination to get what she wants sets her on a collision course with Cam; Reggie meets the peculiar and brilliant man who made Flaherty all his money.
Cam feels the pressure during his first game back in Boston; M-Chuck unearths lingering racial tensions during the family's cultural tour of a plantation.
Reggie meets a college football prospect with a troublesome manager; M-Chuck becomes involved in the life of a pregnant girl.
Chen attempts to woo Cassie at a gala to celebrate the launch of Cam's shoe; Cam makes a mistake with a reporter.
Cam meets a special woman while he contends with a potential career-ending injury; Reggie's representation of Jupiter becomes an exercise in futility.
Cam plans a magical first date for Allison; Uncle Julius takes a jaunt with the police and learns how the other half lives; M-Chuck uses her therapy to heap guilt upon her mother.
Missy is recruited to tutor Jupiter when his draft status is threatened; Cam and Allison's relationship grows, along with Reggie's business ventures.
Reggie has doubts about representing Jupiter; Allison declines Cam's expensive gifts; a crisis rocks the family.
The tragic loss of a loved one leaves family members with a sudden hole in their lives.
The Greenleaf family struggles in the aftermath of Mac's release; Lady Mae makes a last-ditch attempt to save the Bishop; Basie's announcement opens a rift between the Bishop and Jacob.

Grace and Charity oppose Lady Mae's reaction to demands from the Deacon Board; the Bishop visits his father-in-law and runs into Mac; Kerissa and Jacob prepare to move out; Grace goes out with Darius Nash, a journalist following Calvary.
After one of Mac's victims attempts suicide, Grace makes a rash move that may have lasting consequences; Kevin's mother visits, exposing old wounds; Lady Mae tries to make Jacob see reason.
Bishop and Lady Mae preside over Calvary's Fall Revival, and decide to take action against Basie; Both Lady Mae and Grace connect with old friends; Grace confronts Mac's new girlfriend.
When Basie hears about the injunction filed to stop construction of Triumph Two, he stages a sit-in at Calvary in an attempt to force Bishop's hand; Grace's plan to put Mac away hits a snag.
Kevin and Charity begin divorce proceedings, but the circumstances are exacerbated when Lady Mae learns the truth about Kevin; Grace and Darius's relationship reaches a stalemate.
The anniversary of Faith's death is at hand and Grace shows no sign of giving up her pursuit of Mac; Triumph Pastor Basie Skanks and Jacob receive bad news regarding Triumph Two's finances.

The Geckos pursue Amaru to a mysterious Western town, where she plans to open the gates of hell.
With Kate Fuller near death, the team races against an eclipse to defeat Amaru before hell consumes the world.
When bank robbers Seth and Richie Gecko make a run for the border, a pit stop turns into a deadly standoff.
Fleeing the liquor store, Richie’s visions worsen as the Gecko Brothers nearly collide with the Fullers.
Dolph Lundgren stars as a captain trapped on a submarine with Russian terrorists armed with a chemical virus.
A petty criminal rises as a fierce anti-heroine in the dangerous, cutthroat world of diamond smuggling.
Ruby Rose stars as a combat vet who protects an NYC family from a gang out to rob them.
A hitman who stages “accidents” hunts his old crew after his girlfriend is murdered.
The Accident Man battles elite assassins to protect a mafia heir and save his only friend.
Jackie Chan plays a quiet businessman seeking justice after an act of terrorism kills his daughter.
An expert in karate avenges his Chinatown friend, slain by a mobster in Los Angeles.
