The Angels try to help fulfill a dying inventor's dream of finishing his invention which uses water instead of coal as a source of energy.
The Angels must intercede when a troubled teen goes on trial for violent behavior as a result of his obsession with a video game.

programmes.st: The Show Must Not Go On
programmes.d: The Angels help unite a community which has been torn apart by a generation gap.

programmes.st: At The End Of The Aisle
programmes.d: The Angels reunite with an old friend on the eve of her wedding to an agnostic man and try to stop her from making a mistake she will regret.
It is judgment day for Monica, who is up for review, and facing her most challenging mission yet.
When the case against Zack goes to trial and the circumstantial evidence against him piles up, threats are made against his life and he is then placed in protective custody.
Byron Sully, an enigmatic man whose closest companions are the Indians and a wolf, becomes Mike's friend as she struggles for acceptance.
Dr. Quinn immediately takes action to stop the spread of a deadly epidemic.

Mike's stoic, disapproving Bostonian mother, Elizabeth, who, after years of estrangement, visits her daughter in Colorado Springs but finds her unconventional life on the frontier difficult to accept.
When a starving orphaned immigrant takes desperate measures to feed his siblings, the only thing standing between him and a noose is Kid Cole, the new sheriff.
Loren, the unforgiving father-in-law, threatens to take back Sully's homestead.
Michaela worries when Charlotte's husband, Ethan Cooper, comes back to the family he abandoned, convincing almost everyone of his newfound ways.
When the town's water supply is tainted with mercury by a wealthy mining baron, many people become sick and Dr. Mike threatens the miner to clean it up or have his land taken away.
When Doc Eli, a medicine-show man, arrives in town professing to have created the perfect bottled elixir, Mike sets out to call his bluff, especially when her children's health becomes jeopardized.
A wandering cowboy abandons his baby boy and leaves him in Dr. Mike's care.
Progress comes to Colorado Springs, and Sully pays the price.
A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

Two worlds come together when HIGHLANDER big-screen star Christopher Lambert teams up with HIGHLANDER television series star Adrian Paul to combat a fearsome villain and his ruthless band of immortals.
Presented by Quentin Tarantino, Iron Monkey is the spirited tale of a mysterious and mythical Chinese legend in this exhilarating non-stop martial arts excitement.
Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.
An inspector and his unit are after a crime boss and are willing to capture him at all costs. The crime boss enlists his top henchmen to end their dirty schemes.
The creators of Kill Zone take action to the next level with a breakthrough combination of hard-hitting mixed martial arts battles and nail-biting tension.
Ip Man is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, the grandmaster of the Wing Chun style of kung fu and sifu of legendary martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee.

Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

In this explosive third installment of the blockbuster martial arts series, when a band of brutal gangsters led by crooked property developer (Mike Tyson) make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programmes.st: Pinky Up The River/Long John Pinky
programmes.d: 'Pinky Up The River': The Panther opens a river rafting operation only to encounter competition from Manly Man. 'Long John Pinky': The Panther gets shanghaied into being the cook aboard a pirate ship and must outsmart the dreaded Captain R. Gyle.

While traipsing in a snooty Nob Hill area, Charlie and Itchy are lured into a dog trap set by a bratty little kid named Teddy, who has been capturing and sending dogs to the Dogcatcher. When things go awry, Anabelle decides she must step in to help.

When an uptight, 'by the book' guardian angel dog named Lance arrives on the scene, Charlie feels threatened by his 'perfection.' To make matters worse, Itchy has become enamored with the do-gooder Lance, and becomes his partner.

Charlie and Itchy are given the assignment of finding a rambunctious pup a home. But the little guy is a terror, with a massive appetite to boot! But when things get t0o much, Charlie and Itchy come up with a plan to deal with the little mutt.

Itchy is 'dognapped' by Maxine, a socially challenged rich girl who thinks Itchy is her only friend. Charlie attempts to break his friend out of his prison, but when he finally gets in, he suddenly revels in the wealth. Why Hurry?  Free eats!
A film about a mean and violent werewolf is shot in Wolverton. Outraged by the poor misrepresentation of werewolves, Scott decides to be a stuntman in order to change the horror film into a comedy.
Scott becomes infatuated with Shayna the She-Wolf, a T.V. personality who he believes to be a real teen wolf, like himself. He and Stiles decide to travel to Hollywood and find her.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

programmes.st: The Curse of the Red Paw
programmes.d: Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.
Sabrina and Chloe try to compete with Gem by fitting into the latest fad jeans.

programmes.st: Nothin' Says Lovin' Like Something From a Coven
programmes.d: After being dissed from Gem's Halloween party, Sabrina throws a Halloween party of her own.
Sabrina competes with Gem for office of Class President. They play dirty until Gem accuses her of being weird. Sabrina goes to disastrous lengths to prove her wrong.
Sabrina's band, the Flavor Babes, use a little magic to launch their careers. The much desired fame and riches end up tearing Sabrina, Chloe, Hilda and Zelda apart.
Zane hears of a treasure under the ocean and enlists the girls to find it. Rikki is injured in the search. Zane gives Rikki the reward. Charlotte contrives to keep Lewis from the girls.
Emma starts acting weird after pricking her finger on a barb of coral. Cleo’s fish Hector exhibits the same behaviour. Emma becomes more and more like a fish and Lewis has to find a way to cure her.

Don takes the family camping on Mako Island during a Full Moon. The girls are affected and need the moon pool for sanctuary. Charlotte almost slips in the moon pool and realises something weird is going on there.

Emma thinks she’s going to get a promotion at the juice bar but Ash is given the job. Emma and Ash clash over the job, but we discover it’s over a lot more. Meanwhile, Lewis stands up to Charlotte over spending time with Cleo.

Unbeknownst to the boys, Cassy's been doing volunteer work before and after class, helping Dr. Mender, the resident bestial physician, tend to injured enchanted creatures. Cassy discovers she has a real gift for healing.
Class clown, Gus, is big on getting laughs. Cassy thinks she's just as funny and a competition begins.

Cassy is assigned to tend the school garden, where she discovers that the flowers are shrinking instead of growing. While trying to save a flower, she's yanked into “Rootopia,” – a bizarre underground realm.

After Samantha, Gus and Verne save a magical carpet from Zarlak, they've got to go back to their least favorite class at the Enchanted School -- Magical Histories, taught by their least favorite teacher -- the dull and boring Mr. Sternwand.
Lewis and Zane find an old myth about mermaids is true – the scent of ambergris sends them wild. But it backfires when sleazy Nate gets hold of the scent and has all three mermaid girls on his arm!
Rikki tries to avoid Zane when he comes back, but needs his help after an incident with a speedboat. Meanwhile, Charlotte continues to flirt with Lewis and Cleo worries for their secret.

Cleo and Rikki push Ash into asking Emma out again – little did they know he’d turn up at Emma’s place in time for a full moon! Rikki and Cleo are both moonstruck and Ash looks set to discover Emma’s secret.
For the first anniversary of the girls being mermaids, Cleo decides to throw a party. However, Emma and Rikki fall out following a fight between Ash and Zane and Cleo may have to celebrate alone.

Lewis discovers someone called Max Hamilton did research fifty years ago on the strange properties of Mako Island. Lewis tracks the old man down and finds that he knows a lot more about mermaids than Lewis first thought.

Charlotte demands answers to why Lewis is hanging out with the girls so much. She believe an excuse from Cleo, but then a discovery from inside Max's research brings her to the secret! Meanwhile, Ash decides to help Emma with her fear of water.
Marshall and Simon think they've finally found someone who will believe them - a traveling professor of the 'parabelievable.' But should they be believing him?
During Errie's annual Tornado day, Matt Frewer drops in as a wacky meteorologist whom Marshall helps battle Tornado Bob.
Marshall and Simon are startled by a creepy kid who's living in an old mill that's haunted by the ghost of Eerie's worst bank robber ever.
Trickery makes Marshall the new Harvest King, and he finds the king's traditional task no treat:  he must venture to see the Eerie Wolf, which turns out to be a werewolf.
Aspiring artist Ralph Philips is focused on perfecting his art.
When Eight-year-old Mary Anne moves to a new neighborhood, she meets two boys who don't know the meaning of kindness.
Fourteen year old Erin has little else to do in her small town than to make up stories.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.
Frasier takes the bus with Roz for the first time, and Frasier uses Martin to meet a woman at a retirement home. Niles and Daphne recreate a date.
Frasier adopts the role of cultural mentor to Todd Peterson, a Silicon Valley billionaire who's just become the station's new owner.
Tension builds as Mel subjects Niles to social humiliation before granting him a divorce. Finally, he can no longer endure the disrespect, and the situation explodes at a party.

Donny drops the lawsuit against Frasier and Daphne because he's met another woman whom he has decided to marry. Frasier dates his lawyer, Abbey, but accuses her of overcharging him for legal expenses.
Frasier betrays Roz by staying friends with her cheating ex-boyfriend.
Frasier reluctantly co-hosts Seattle's Christmas parade with his radio rival.
Frasier is awarded the Lifetime Achievement Award. Martin, his father, accepts on his behalf because Frasier is off analyzing his own life with his old Harvard mentor, Professor Tewsbury.
Frasier decides that three generations of Crane men should head out to the woods for some family bonding, despite their protests.
Frasier and Niles go back to school to learn about auto mechanics.
Frasier and Niles try to revitalize the career of their boyhood Shakespearean actor/idol, only to learn that he stinks.
Frasier's dating destiny unfolds in a pair of parallel universes.
Niles and Daphne decide to go on a diet. Roz tries a new pheromonal perfume that attracts men. Frasier goes on a date with Eileen, Kenny's wife.
After Niles sinks an impossible half-court shot, Frasier finds him impossible to live with.
Roz puts together a space documentary with Senator John Glenn. Niles learns to fly a kite.
Frasier and Niles press Martin's rich girlfriend to save their bankrupt prep school.

Frasier leaves his wine club to host a new radio feature called "The Wine Corner" and is angered to learn that a resentful Niles, the club's overbearing "corkmaster," has ordered its old members not to participate in the program.
Niles and Daphne "get real" about their romance and their idealized impressions of each other.
Daphne attempts to prove to Niles that she has psychic visions, and Frasier is ego-stricken when he discovers that Roz is having an affair with his mentor.
Frasier runs into an old high school friend and finds that he is attracted to her friend, Claire.
Frasier tutors Lana's son in exchange for a date with Claire. Martin goes to a dog party, and Daphne and Niles have trouble sleeping in the same bed.
Frasier's vacation plans with Claire turn disastrous when Daphne, Niles, and Martin show up at the same resort and Frasier starts dreaming about Lana.

Niles gets jealous of an old flame of Daphne's at the dog park; Frasier teaches Lana about honesty in selling a problematic piece of real estate, and Martin secretly attends the parole hearing of the man who shot him.
Frasier has trouble deciding between two women and ends up losing them both. Niles mistakenly goes to a local beach in the buff.
Troubled by his recent relationship woes, Frasier goes to the country for peace and quiet, but ends up facing the ghosts of failed relationships past.
Daphne is tortured by pangs of jealousy when she learns one of Niles's patients is in love with him. Frasier and Martin go to extreme lengths to catch a cricket hiding in the apartment.
Martin goes back to work as a security guard and reflects on his last day as a cop, when he was shot.

Roz comes face-to-face with her own snobbery when she dates a garbage man. Frasier's plan to convince his co-workers that he isn't an elitist snob backfires when he becomes more popular than he wants.

Frasier's psychological party game brings unpleasant revelations at his Halloween party. Niles dresses as Martin and gets drunk on beer. The children in the apartment building believe that Frasier eats kids' brains.
On their 8th anniversary of living together, Frasier accidentally destroys Martin's recliner. Niles discovers Daphne has no talent for music.
Frasier becomes obsessed with replacing a missing tape in his collection of all 2,000 of his shows.
Blood pressures and spirits rise as an intern becomes the pawn in Frasier and Niles' battle over a wine cellar tour.
Frasier's show has been losing the ratings to a hot new program, Dr. Zach, which has a heavy advertising budget. KACL refuses to match their exposure, so Frasier calls on Bebe to turn the screws.
Martin gets criticized at work and decides to let it go; however, Frasier and Niles can't. They decide to interfere, which leads to a lengthy confinement in a storage room.
Two figure skating rivals are banned from the sport after a brawl over the gold medal. Joining forces, they find a loophole in the rules that allows them to skate again... as a pair!

There’s only one thing keeping aspiring executive Tim from corporate success. He must find the perfect guest to bring to his boss’s monthly dinner party, where the winner of the evening is the one who arrives with the biggest buffoon.

programmes.st: MST3K Shorts: The Sport Parade: Snow Thrills
programmes.d: A classic newsreel that highlights various winter sports.
The Earl of Curl beauty parlor is a front for a cat burglar ring targeting wealthy women. Sledge infiltrates the ring by going undercover as a second-story man.
Sledge and Dori must safely escort a defecting Soviet scientist on a passenger train filled with Communist agents determined to take him back.
Thad's behavior takes a turn for the worse after he suffers a concussion making it difficult for Daniels to hide the injury from both Gilday and the NCAA.
ONE WEEK, a HARD KNOCKS-esque television series, is at BMS following the team and its coaches both on and off the field.
An obsessive-compulsive giant ape needs a job, and Callie struggles with her sudden attraction to Twayne.
Randall joins a zombie cult, and Mark performs psychiatric evaluations on his coworkers.
The family's summer trip to the lakeside cabin takes one vexing turn after another, and Kevin relives a traumatic childhood moment.
An unwelcome surprise sends Frank's bromance with Chet into a tailspin. Maureen and Phillip train for their big day. Bill's breakup gets messy.

Greg Davies abuses his position of power to make five comics take on more tenuous tasks and this week they have to try and surprise Alex Horne when he emerges from his shed after an hour cooped up inside.

As the series reaches its midway point, Greg Davies's onslaught of tasks don't get any easier – with domino rallies, flag meals and, when asked to fill an eggcup with sweat, Al Murray goes to extreme lengths to maximise his point potential.
Denholm forces everyone at Reynholm Industries to take a stress test, then threatens to ax anyone who's still experiencing stress by day's end.
Jen's flirtation with a company security guard gets a little out of hand when he mistakes her pretend knowledge for the real thing.
The deputies raise money selling delicious Coconut Nut Clusters door-to-door.
Dangle reconnects with his family after his estranged father passes away.
The department's new bulletproof vests for women have an unexpected side effect: super knockers.
Rick the Burger Cousin manager is a cruel taskmaster when deputies go undercover flipping burgers.
The Weirs take Nick into their home after he has an argument with his father; Sam's romantic dreams come true.
Sam discovers that having a dream come true may not be such a good thing; Ken's new relationship is threatened by a disturbing piece of information about his girlfriend.
The guys campaign for Jillian to become break room manager so that they can get access to Alice's Costco card, but Jillian quickly turns into a snack tyrant.
After Alice gets mad at Adam, Blake and Ders for trying to have an office fish fry, the guys go in search of a male prostitute to sex her out of her bad mood.
Jon’s new next-door neighbor is a cat hater and Garfield has to find out why. All of the farmyards are caught in a repeating cycle of zany bits.

programmes.st: Mind Over Matter/Orson at the Bat/The Multiple-Choice Cartoon
programmes.d: Jon takes Garfield and Odie to see the mind reader Suami Pastrami. Orson and the gang are playing baseball when he gets hit on the head and dreams his team is playing against his brothers. Garfield gives a multiple choice quiz.

Jon gets a speeding ticket from a phony cop and decides to protest in court. Orson teaches Wade how by using one's imagination, anything is possible. Garfield is reliving Robinson Crusoe while Jon persuades a repairman to fix the cable.

programmes.st: Return of the Buddy Bears/Much Ado About Lanolin/Reigning Cats and Dogs
programmes.d: The Buddy Bears help Garfield clean the house./Orson and the gang do a performance of "Taming of the Shrew."/Garfield hosts a TV debate.
Myron the Mouse tries to goad Garfield into chasing him. Edward R. Furrow is back psychoanalyzing the weasel and Orson.

programmes.st: Box O' Fun/U.S Acres: Unidentified Flying Orson/School Daze
programmes.d: Garfield plays in an empty cardboard box./Orson's science fiction book inspires Roy to play a trick./Jon sends Garfield to a school for cats run by an ex-Marine.
In Frontier America, Jonny Ragweedseed and his cat make sure that ragweed will cover the land.
Irwin the Mouse wants to be cast and Garfield lets him be one. Wade visits the Sage on a mountain to see how to overcome his fears.

programmes.st: Weighty Problem/U.S. Acres: The Worm Turns/Good Cat, Bad Cat
programmes.d: Garfield tampers with the new talking scale./Booker's hunt for worms comes to a stop./Garfield's good and bad side battle for control.
Heather keeps leading Jon on, while only wanting Garfield for herself.

This sometimes very funny and sometimes highly emotional anthology follows Garfield's nine lives throughout history, from his first life as a prehistoric cat-Neanderthal to his ninth life as an astronaut in a jam.

programmes.st: Night of the Living Laundromat/Fast Food/Cash and Carry
programmes.d: Jon buys a washing machine that is actually alive and eats his clothes. Bo is the slowest cook ever, and Roy opens a fast food joint. Jon cancels all his credit cards and takes Garfield and Odie to the mall to buy a new waste-basket.
Jon’s niece has to be retrieved by Garfield and Odie. Garfield gets confidence from a motivational speaker.
Jon’s bumbling cousin comes to stay. Garfield is turned into a werewolf.

programmes.st: Binky Gets Cancelled Again/Orson's Diner/Flat Tired
programmes.d: Binky loses his show to The Buddy Bears./Orson and Wade open a diner./Garfield is too tired to do the show.

programmes.st: The Curse of Klopman/Mud Sweet Mud/Rainy Day Dreams
programmes.d: Garfield inherits the cursed diamond./The farm folk decide to clean up the place, Orson's waller becomes a prime objective./While Jon hosts a lady friend on a rainy day.

programmes.st: Squeak Previews/U.S Acres: Dr. Jekyll & Mr. Wade/A Tall Tale
programmes.d: Two mice critics review a documentary./Wade is mistakenly hypnotized to turn into a monster./The network insists that Nermal tell a story.
Jon, Garfield and Odie visit Cactus Jake./When Roy and Wade have a fight, Orson wonders what Hogcules would do./Garfield discovers a secret world inside a tree.
When Garfield has an accident on the new satellite antennae, he ends up in the TV./Orson Can't get to sleep./Jon decides to learn karate.

programmes.st: Stick To It/Orson In Wonderland/For Cats Only
programmes.d: Garfield tells Odie to stay in one spot./During a croquet game, Orson finds a large hole./Garfield hosts a special, on KAT TV.
Garfield the cat daydreams that he's an old-time private detective.
A fast-talking salesman cons Jon. CatTV airs the latest video, “That’s Called Bein’ A Cat.”

programmes.st: Cabin Fever/U.S. Acres: Return of Power Pig/Fair Exchange
programmes.d: Garfield and Odie are snowbound in a cabin with no food./A monster circulates around the farm, Orson dons his "Power Pig" togs./Garfield dreams he changes places with Jon.

programmes.st: Fraidy Cat/U.S. Acres: Shell Shocked Sheldon/Nothing to Sneeze At
programmes.d: Garfield and Odie watch a horror film./Orson decides to hatch Sheldon./Garfield has a sneezing attack.
Garfield sleeps for twenty years and awakens to a strange future./Roy convinces Wade that the "law of gravity" has been repealed./The arrival of homemade cookies signal a "cat and mouse" game.
When Garfield and Odie are out trick-or-treating, they end up at a haunted house.
Garfield uses Nermal’s cuteness to get goodies. The crew finds a chocolate mine.
Garfield and Odie fantasize that they are on a Middle-East mission to retrieve the Banana of Bombay, the symbol of humour to nations around the world.
Garfield relates the tale of a lousy Italian chef (Jon). The Buddy Bears present a cultural moment.
Ichabod Cricket shows up to be Garfield’s conscience, and everything backfires.
Garfield is adopted by an elderly lady. Roy buys a robot that creates weather.
Garfield and Odie trick Jon into not taking a trip on his vacation.

programmes.st: The Binky Show/U.S. Acres: Keeping Cool/Don't Move!
programmes.d: Garfield decides to win Jon a birthday present on a game show./When Orson's brothers come to torment him./Odie must remain outside a pet store.
Prof. Payne helps Jim to identify a ghost, and when Melinda comes back home, she and Jim must help the ghost's younger sister, who seems to be following in the dangerous footsteps of the ghost.

Melinda encounters the spirit of a woman who died in a snowstorm 20 years ago after her car slid off a road in a heavily wooded area. The woman wants Melinda's help in finding her young daughter who was in the car with her the night of the accident.
Melinda tries to help an angry ghost clear his name when she sees him in a restaurant that is burning down for the second time.
Melinda tries to help a former rock star named Brandon who is apparently being harassed by his father's ghost.

Melinda encounters an angry ghost at a high school baseball game. Matt, the angry ghost of a former pro baseball player who died in a terrible car accident, tries to possess Justin Cotter, a young pitcher.

An eerie, mud-covered ghost transports Melinda from her house to an exotic jungle, but the ghost is unfortunately limited in speech due to a horrible condition, making it hard for Melinda to understand how she can help him.
When Melinda has a hard time talking to the newest ghost in her life, she soon learns that the reason why he visited her is because he is in a coma.

A ghost who can recall his previous lives appears to be destined for another reincarnation as the child of Melinda's pregnant friend---but the spirit doesn't want to return and actively seeks to harm the unborn baby.
When her Jeep breaks down on a deserted road, Melinda gets involved with a mystery when a spirit who looks like a skeleton gives her a warning to stay away.
Following a career-week presentation at Grandview High, Melinda sees the spirit of a cheerleader attack her former squad-mates.
Melinda's life is put on the line when a desperate spirit leads her to a criminal.
Melinda is bewildered when she deals with the ghost of Jason Bennett, a man who died 10 years prior before his high school graduation.

When Melinda and Jim take in a foster child, they soon discover that the girl's dead mother is attached to her. With the help of Professor Payne, Melinda is able to get the woman to reveal her spirit in order to find out why she hasn't crossed over yet.
After seeing Delia's husband's spirit sabotaging Delia's date, Melinda must reveal her identity to Delia in order to help.
Melinda meets Gabriel, another whisperer with similar abilities. However, her fascination with meeting someone like her turns to fear when she finds a connection between him and Payne's wife.
Melinda worries about her loved ones when a ghost shows her visions of a deadly future. Meanwhile, a deadly ghost whisperer continues to lurk around.
Worried that the dark side is overtaking the light, Melinda must solve the meaning behind clues before another tragedy hits Grandview.
When Thorfinn's bones are discovered on the Woodstone property, he asks Sam to conduct the traditional Viking funeral he's always wanted.
When Sam and Jay invite their nosy neighbors to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.
On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who vandalize it every year.
Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she's embarrassed about a part of the story she's never revealed.
After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts.
Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go for a walk with him, hoping it will spark a special memory.
Hetty accidentally possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are about to show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner.
Sam and Jay travel to where Sam's mother, Sheryl (Rachael Harris), died to see if she's now a ghost. Also, Sasappis divulges a secret he overheard Sam and Jay discussing to his fellow ghosts.
When Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), comes to visit Sam and Jay after being dumped by her boyfriend, they're shocked to discover that she's communicating with someone they know on a dating app.
Just as Sam and Jay are set to host a friend's wedding that could get their B&B business off the ground, the ghost of Hetty's husband, Elias Woodstone (Matt Walsh), tries to ruin it.

When Sasappis offers to help Sam complete the B&B website so they can start taking reservations, they butt heads over creative direction. Also, Pete bonds with Jay over basketball until Jay makes a friend, and Flower tries to be Pete's basketball buddy.
When Sam and Jay have the ghosts bunk together to free up rooms for guests at the B&B, they learn that Thorfinn has been having night terrors, which inspires Sam to enlist a therapist to help him.

The secret about Trevor's missing pants is finally revealed when his wealthy former friend comes to Woodstone Mansion to buy the timepiece Sam and Jay found on Elias Woodstone's corpse. Also, Thor decides to tell Flower how he feels about her.

An '80s "mean girl" ghost named Stephanie (Odessa A'Zion), who died on her prom night, is awakened in the attic, triggering Sam to confront what happened on her own prom night. Also, Alberta discovers she has another special gift.

As Sam and Jay await the arrival of their first official bed-and-breakfast guests, they face obstacles triggered by a Norse curse placed upon them by Thorfinn, and Isaac takes a huge, centuries-in-the-making step in his personal life.
Sam enlists the Ghosts to help secure a good review from an overly critical couple staying at the B&B. Also, Isaac tries to bring Nigel into his friend group in the second-season premiere.
Sam decides to host a podcast exploring the mystery surrounding Alberta's death. Also, Hetty develops an unusual relationship with a broken washing machine.

Sam becomes alarmed when the ghosts suggest Jay's new friends may be part of a cult run by a charismatic leader named Micah (Drew Tarver). Also, Pete changes his attitude after Sasappis criticizes his unceasing cheeriness.

Sasappis convinces Sam and Jay to try saving an old tree on the Woodstone property that the neighbors want to cut down. Also, Thor attempts to become more environmentally friendly to get Flower's attention.

programmes.st: Halloween 2: The Ghost of Hetty's Past
programmes.d: A séance at Sam and Jay's last-minute Halloween party conjures up a spirit from Hetty's past. Also, Isaac worries Nigel will be turned off by his ghost power.
Sam meets a Viking ghost at the Farnsbys' house who has an unexpected connection to Thorfinn. Also, Trevor devises a new method for the ghosts to trade favors.
When a television documentary crew comes to Woodstone Mansion to shoot an episode of "Dumb Deaths," Pete confronts a hard truth about the day he died.

Alberta's past expertise comes in handy when Sam and Jay run into complications during their Woodstone whiskey-tasting soiree. Also, Trevor devises a ghost fraternity, which inspires a revelation from Isaac's past.
Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), visits Woodstone Mansion and brings along an adoring male friend, inspiring Sam to spark a romance between them in the spirit of the holiday rom-coms she loves.

Sam and Thorfinn get caught in the crossfire as the scheme Jay's sister, Bela (Punam Patel), and the ghosts have conjured up goes awry. Isaac's marriage to Beatrice sheds light on how apprehensive he has been in communicating his feelings to Nigel.

Sam and Jay are thrilled when they find a highly qualified assistant for the B&B; however, their new employee comes with some surprising baggage. Also, Thorfinn tries to help his son, Bjorn, deal with a bully.

Sam gives relationship advice to her and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), ignoring Hetty's warning not to get too close to "the help." Also, Sasappis strikes up a romance with Jessica (Nichole Sakura), the ghost who lives in Freddie's car.

Sam and Jay's assistant, Freddie (Mike Lane), purchases ghost-hunting equipment when suspicious activity leads him to theorize the B&B is haunted. Also, Sasappis risks losing his relationship with Jessica (Nichole Sakura) when Freddie sells his car.
Trevor receives disturbing news about his parents when they come to Woodstone B&B to collect his newly discovered remains. Also, Isaac and Nigel's relationship hits a roadblock.
Sam and Jay help Thorfinn create a perfect first date with Flower. Also, Hetty feels slighted by the ghosts' new housemate, Nigel.

Sam struggles to keep Isaac's spirits up after she hits a wall trying to publish a biography about him. Also, Trevor and Hetty conspire to keep their relationship hidden, and Thor tries to prove to Flower that he can control his anger.

Elias Woodstone returns to Woodstone seeking Hetty's forgiveness so he can stay out of hell for good. Also, Jay struggles to repeat an inspired culinary creation that he came up with after walking through Flower.
To force the world to buy her over-priced, worthless new car, the Arachna, Spydra heads back to visit Henry Ford and destroy his original Assembly Line.
Gadget Boy must go undercover as legendary pick-pocketer Tom Thumbnail in order to infiltrate Spydra’s senior criminal team before they steal any more world treasures!
With the invention of her new Metabolizer Helmet, which can create whatever the wearer is thinking of, Spydra heads back in time to 1861, Switzerland.

programmes.st: The Day the Gadget Boy Stood Still
programmes.d: Spydra releases her Giant Spider Aliens to work as evil minions and land in Washington DC.  She makes demands for world peace, and a billion dollars in cash.
Spydra is tired of being fooled by Dabble and his brilliant inventions, and of being pursued by Gadget Boy and Co. through time.
Spydra has collected evil crystals that can make the statues of the world do her bidding in her goal for world coverage!
From M.A.D. headquarters to a secret military base, Inspector Gadget and Penny track down jets stolen by Dr. Claw.
M.A.D. has stolen all of Metro City's water and plans to hold it for ransom.  It is up to Inspector Gadget to recover the missing water.
Dr. Stench, an agent of M.A.D., has invented a substance that makes gold smell terrible.  Since smelly gold cannot be kept in bank vaults, it will be valueless in international markets.
Inspector Gadget protects Nick Defecto.  M.A.D. is trying to destroy him because of the secret he knows.
M.A.D. has invented a weather machine that controls the weather and is demanding money from cities.  Inspector Gadget has to find and destroy the machine.
Inspector Gadget's mission is to stop M.A.D. from kidnapping the scientists of the world and holding them for ransom.
Inspector Gadget's mission is to guard a priceless coin collection from the evil clutches of M.A.D.
Millionaires in Paris are being robbed of their jewels and money.  M.A.D. is behind the plot; sending warning notes in advance.
Dr. Claw has invented a spray that rots wood instantly.  If he is not paid one million dollars, he will destroy every forest in the world.
Inspector Gadget's mission is to foil Dr. Claw from stealing the Star of Istanbul.
M.A.D. is threatening to steal the King of Fuzug's treasure. Inspector Gadget's mission is to save the treasure from Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget protects Fang the Wonderdog from M.A.D. who wants to kidnap Fang and make millions in ransom.
Inspector Gadget, Brain, and Penny foil the evil plans of Dr. Claw's henchman from the LeDip School for Pickpockets as they try to steal the Inspector's new watch.
Inspector Gadget protects armored cars full of money from the dangerous Dr. Claw.

programmes.st: Gadget in Winterland AKA Winter Olympics (The Pilot)
programmes.d: In the pilot episode, Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Brain are headed for fun and relaxation in Winterland, the site of the Olympic Games.
Dr. Claw schemes with two magicians, the Lesser and the Great Wambini, to steal gold bars from the bank vault.

Pets owned by the city's rich and famous are disappearing, and Inspector Gadget's job is to investigate and locate the missing pets. The MAD magician, the Great Wambini, invites the missing pet owners to a siance.
Chief Quimby warns Inspector Gadget of a MAD plot to steal the famous King of Alpacastan's llama that spits diamonds.
Chief Quimby reveals a MAD plot to steal Metro City's gold to Inspector Gadget. Inspector Gadget is instructed to proceed to the mint and stop the robbery, while Penny and Brain follow.

As Inspector Gadget is washing the Gadget mobile, he promises to teach Capeman the rules of crime fighting. Chief Quimby arrives to inform Inspector Gadget of MAD's eighth anniversary, which will be celebrated with eight bold crimes.
Dr. Claw plots with Dr. Noodleman to dismantle Gadget of his gadgets with the aid of various vintage hospital surgical tools.

programmes.d: A woman accuses a former employee of fraud and forging a customer's contract; a woman sues her cousin for kicking her out and disposing of her belongings.
A man accuses his employee of stealing bikes from his failing business; old friends go their separate ways over the cost of a hair weave and a loan to ensure that children would have Christmas gifts.
A man accuses a contractor of racism after he walks into a shower of debris from nearby construction.

programmes.st: Moms' Knife Fight; Phone Jail Break!
programmes.d: Two women come at each other with knives in front of their children; a mother and stepmother fight over a teen's phone.
A woman accuses her former friend of assault and sues her for pain and suffering; the ex-friend countersues for false arrest and a hair weave.
A transgender motorist accuses an off-duty police officer of pulling his gun on her after she rammed into him.

programmes.st: GPS-Tracking Boyfriend!; Living in Mom's Backyard?!
programmes.d: A man discovers that his lover has been cheating on him and decides to track her; a man who lives in the wild sues an ex-roommate for unpaid rent.

programmes.st: Ex-Convict Out for Blood!; Electricity Thief?!
programmes.d: A man flees his rented home, saying a recently released convict threatened to kill him; tenants say they unwittingly paid for electric cattle barriers on 40 acres of land.

programmes.st: The Rapidly Aging Yorkie!; Cheerleading, Bullying and Bows!
programmes.d: A woman is shocked to learn that the "puppy" she purchased is really 7 years old; a mom says her daughter's cheerleading coach stole money from her.

programmes.st: Minister-in-Training Cheater?; Teen Entrepreneur Ripped Off!
programmes.d: A man denies calling escorts, cheating on his ex, and damaging a car; a customer takes advantage of a teen running a lawn-mowing service.

programmes.st: Famous Rock Star's Rappin' Cousin?!; VIP Vegas Princess!
programmes.d: A woman says a musician conned her into thinking he was related to a rock star; a woman sues her ex for not paying for dinner at a high-end restaurant.

programmes.st: The Downton Abbey School of Loan Sharks!
programmes.d: With a lender on trial, threats of death and dismemberment come into play.

One of the girls in Ricky's show quits, creating a vacancy which Lucy wants to fill. She goes down for an audition and can have the part provided she loses twelve ponds in four days to fit into the previous singer's size 12 outfit.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky Is Trying To Murder Her
programmes.d: Lucy is reading "The Mockingbird Murder Mystery" when Ethel reads her fortune and tells her death is near. Later she overhears a conversation between Ricky and his agent and she jumps to the wrong conclusion that he's trying to do away with her.
When Ricky cuts off Lucy's allowance and charge accounts because of her careless spending, Lucy finds herself short of funds. Ethel has tickets to a radio quiz show that has a cash prize of $1,000.
Network television scouts are going to check out Ricky's band and Lucy tries to "get into the act" in order to be discovered as well. Of course Ricky will not hear of it.
Lucy becomes interested in numerology and advises Ricky that it is a good day for him to make any deals he can. However, she soon realizes that she consulted the horoscope from yesterday's newspaper.
When Ricky leaves his clothes around the living room, Lucy gets angry and divides the room in half so Ricky can be as messy as he likes - on his side!

Ricky brings home a $3,500 mink coat to be used in his nightclub act, and Lucy assumes it's her anniversary present. Trying to get the coat away from her becomes a problem because Lucy not only wears it while she does housework, she even sleeps in it.
Ethel Mertz interprets a gossip column item to mean that Ricky is interested in one of the chorus girls in his nightclub. Ricky assures Lucy that it's just publicity.

programmes.st: Lucy Thinks Ricky has Been Drafted
programmes.d: Lucy opens a telegram addressed to Ricky from the War Department ordering him to appear at the Army's Fort Dix. This letter plus the drills Ricky and Fred have been practicing in the living room convince the women that their husbands have been drafted.

Lucy learns that Ricky needs a dancer for his Parisian nightclub act and is determined to get the part. Fred offers to teach her how to dance but Ethel arranges instead to have the nephew of the woman who runs the French laundry to give pointers.

Ethel wants Ricky to headline a benefit for her women's club. Lucy will only try to arrange it if she is on the bill as well. After hearing Lucy's terrible singing voice, Ethel is less than eager, but eventually agrees.

Lucy buys a costly dress, and when Ricky tells her to take it back or pay for it herself, she decides to get a job. She answers an ad for a babysitter and finds herself in charge of high-spirited twin boys who are to appear in an amateur contest.

Lucy's neighbor Miss Lewis has a crush on Mr. Ritter, the local grocer but istoo shy to invite him to dinner. Trying to play Cupid, Lucy invites him for her but he gets the idea that Lucy has fallen for him. Apparently Mr. Ritter is fond of Lucy as well.

In a deception planned to convince Ricky that she ought to be in his new nightclub act, Lucy pretends to have a nervous breakdown. She consults a book on abnormal psychology that reveals three complexes she assumes.
Lucy decides to break into show business by writing a play about a Cuban tobacco picker and entering it in her women's club play competition. Of course she wants Ricky to star in it but he refuses.
The Mertzes enjoy an evening singing around the piano with the Ricardos in their apartment. When they retire for the night and Lucy and Ricky continue singing, Ethel phones them demanding quiet.

Ricky needs a ballet dancer and a burlesque comic for his club's new musical revue. Lucy wants the ballet gig and takes dance lessons from a strict instructor. Learning the disciplined art is much more difficult than she imagined.

Peggy, a teenage neighbor, breaks up with her boyfriend Arthur because she is infatuated with Ricky. Lucy tries to help the clumsy schoolboy learn how to dance in order to win back Peggy's affections. To complicate matters more, Arthur falls for Lucy.

Lucy and Ethel are eager to get a closer look at the belongings of the O'Briens, new neighbors in the building. They snoop around in their apartment while they are away and when they hear the O'Briens return, Lucy is trapped in the closet.

After the Mertzes have a quarrel the Ricardos try their best to get them back together. Lucy invites each of them to dinner without the other knowing. The Mertzes finally reconcile but in the process, the Ricardos squabble.

Lucy hates the mustache that Ricky grows for a potential movie role and demands that he shave it off. When he refuses, Lucy gets a fake beard and glues it on her face. To teach Ricky a lesson, she kisses her husband with the beard on when he arrives home.

When Ricky forbids Lucy from gossiping, she tapes her mouth shut but reveals the latest rumor to Ethel through charades. However, it seems it's the proverbial black pot and kettle when Ricky shares with Fred a spicy tidbit about one of his band members.

Lucy and Ethel are tired of their dishpan hands and demand dishwashers from their husbands. They also don't think the Society Matrons League, a club they want to join, would approve. Their husbands believe they have it easy compared to the olden days.

A close inspection of her marriage license convinces Lucy that she and Ricky are not legally married. Because his name is misspelled on the certificate, Lucy insists Ricky go through the entire courtship and ultimately the marriage ceremony again.

Ricky discovers a wad of cash in Lucy's purse and closet full of strange valuables and assumes they're all her ill-gotten gains. He doesn't realize Lucy has been legitimately collecting for her club's fundraising bazaar.

Lucy feels left out when Ricky's two Cuban friends visit and converse mainly in Spanish. When she learns that little Renita, someone Ricky once danced with, is coming to town, she insists they reunite for a number.

Lucy and Ethel acquire a walk-in meat freezer. In an attempt to save money, they order two sides of beef, not realizing this is a tremendous amount. Hundreds of pounds of meat and $483 later, they must figure out a way to unload the beef.

Ricky is the emcee for a television variety show and Lucy wants to appear in one of its commercials. To prove to her husband that she has screen presence, she removes the inner parts of their TV set, gets into it, and does a commercial as he arrives home.

As a publicity stunt to further Ricky's career, Lucy pretends she's an exotic princess from "Franistan" who has traveled halfway around the world to see Ricky perform. She books a suite at the Waldorf-Astoria and gets a lot of press attention.

When Lucy screws up a dinner appointment with Ricky's new boss, Mr. Littlefield, and his wife because she is late, Ricky puts her on a strict time schedule. Later Ricky meets with Littlefield to discuss his possible promotion to manager of the club.

programmes.st: Lucy Gets Ricky On The Radio
programmes.d: Ricky impresses Lucy and the Mertzes with all the answers to a radio quiz show they are enjoying. He doesn't let on that the reason he knows the answers is that he was present at the taping. Lucy is so impressed that she signs him up as a contestant.

Ricky begins wearing a hat around the apartment because he thinks he's going bald. Lucy thinks he's worrying needlessly but goes to a store that specializes in hair restoration in order to help Ricky feel better.

Ricky tries to get a raise from his boss Mr. Littlefield but he is denied. Littlefield hires another act for the Tropicana and Lucy, Ethel and Fred decide to make sure no one shows up for the opening.
The competition intensifies as another veteran artist returns, and artists must take on the ultimate test of artistry as they freehand their Elimination Tattoos.
One of the competition's most infamous veterans returns to shake up the game, and the pressure is on when the artists are tasked with a new-school Elimination Tattoo.
An emotional Flash Challenge brings the artists to tears, and the alliance becomes a target when a bulletproof pair of veterans returns to battle it out for the title.
The artists can't find relief in a sculptural Flash Challenge, and in honor of one veteran artist's return, the artists must team up to tackle the infamous pinup tattoo.
The final veteran artist's return sparks an old rivalry, the shops struggle to work together during a woodworking Flash Challenge, and artist Tommy Montoya is a guest judge.
A massive twist in the Elimination Challenge sends the artists reeling, and Four Horsemen tattoos bring the end of days for one pair of artists.
The artists must tackle painful coordinating armpit tattoos, and Chris Nunez and Oliver Peck take charge of doling out canvases to the artists for the Elimination Tattoo.
The six remaining shops must use their sales skills to win over the canvases for the chance to tattoo, and the judges send one more shop packing.
The artists create cohesive designs by painting nude models in the Flash Challenge, and some shops miss the mark on an Asian deity-themed Elimination Tattoo.
The final four shops battle it out in a tattoo marathon for a spot in the finale, a chance at $200,000, and the first-ever title of Master Shop.
In the live finale, the final three shops compete for $200,000 and the first-ever title of Master Shop.
Three of the most skilled Ink Masters return to coach teams of the nation's top tattoo artists for a chance at $100,000 and the title of Ink Master.
The Masters must coach their team through the season's first Flash Challenge, and a maze Elimination Tattoo puts the artists' grasps of the fundamentals to the test.
The coaches face off to ensure the survival of their team, and proportion skills are put to the test when the artists must tattoo Greek deities.
The coaches step in during a team-based Flash Challenge, and ingenuity is tested when the artists are tasked with mash-up tattoos.
Precision is tested when the artists must create designs using hole punches, and one coach steps up when a difficult canvas bows out of the Elimination Tattoo.
The coaches must lead by example when they're tasked to ink beneath the chin in the Flash Challenge, and the artists push the envelope with undead-style Elimination Tattoos.

programmes.st: Mystical Hand of the Amorous Monk, Miroku
programmes.d: Miroku, a womanizing delinquent priest, has been collecting Shikon Jewel shards and steals Kagome's shards.

programmes.st: The Cursed Ink of the Hell-Painter
programmes.d: Kotatsu, a painter, sees a dream in which he becomes successful by controlling an army of ogres drawn with ink that has a sacred jewel shard in it.
Naraku appears before Sesshomaru and lends him an arm with a sacred jewel shard embedded in it.

programmes.st: Go Back to Your Own Time, Kagome!
programmes.d: Sesshomaru wields the Tetsusaiga with his borrowed arm against Inuyasha, who fights back with his scabbard.

programmes.st: Despicable Villain! The Mystery of Onigumo!
programmes.d: Kagome has her sacred jewel shards taken away from her and is returned to the present day, unable to return to feudal Japan.
Kagome returns to the shrine in the middle of her date with Hojo. She senses the presence of the Shikon Jewel shards and returns to feudal Japan.

programmes.st: A Wicked Smile; Kikyo's Wandering Soul
programmes.d: Kikyo, who was brought back to life, is living as a priestess.
Kikyo paralyzes Kagome. Inuyasha appears before her. Kikyo has been gathering the souls of dead girls.
Sango, a demon slayer, is invited to Hitomi Castle along with her father, the leader of the demon slayers, and her younger brother, Kohaku.
Sango fights Inuyasha, believing him to be her enemy. Naraku's plan is to have her fight to the death using the power of the Shikon Jewel shard.

programmes.st: The Secret of the Sacred Jewel Revealed!
programmes.d: Sango reveals the secret story of the Shikon Jewel's birth.

programmes.st: The Lake of the Evil Water God
programmes.d: Inuyasha and the gang meet Taromaru, the son of a village leader. They go to the Temple of the Water God, where children are being sacrificed.

programmes.st: The Stone Flower and Shippo’s First Love
programmes.d: In a certain village, Shippo meets a girl named Satsuki. Satsuki believes that her brother, who went to war, will come back.
Husbands are being lured away from their village by a beautiful demon. Their wives ask Miroku to defeat the demon.
Sango goes back to the slayer village in order to fix her Hiraikotsu, and Kagome goes back to the well so she can return to the present day.
Inuyasha is able to escape from the miniature garden with the help of Miroku and the others, and goes to save Kagome.
Sango returns to the demon slayer village and repairs her Hiraikotsu. She also lays her father and her comrades' ashes to rest.

programmes.st: The 50 Year-old Curse of the Dark Priestess
programmes.d: Naraku calls upon a priestess named Tsubaki. Fifty years ago, Tsubaki was defeated by Kikyo when she went after the Shikon Jewel.
Kagome desperately fights the curse placed on her by Tsubaki, a dark priestess. Meanwhile, Kikyo appears before Tsubaki.
Tsubaki's curse steals Kagome's consciousness. Kagome forgets feudal Japan in an illusory world.
Tsubaki visits the onmyoji mansion where she once trained.

programmes.st: Giant Ogre of the Forbidden Tower
programmes.d: Tsubaki is a priestess who was considered to be on par with Kikyo.
One night, someone possesses Sango to attack Miroku. The group examines the centipede demon that they suspect was behind it, but they are mistaken.
There is a rift in Naraku's barrier. But it's the beginning of the month, and when night falls, Inuyasha loses his demon powers.
Kagura approaches Sesshomaru and tells him to kill Naraku, but Sesshomaru refuses.
Shippo is sent a letter challenging him to a battle. The letter's sender is Soten Raijyu, and he is still just a child.
A demon born from a piece of flesh that Naraku discarded transforms into a man without a face and steals the handsome face of Muso, a traveling monk.
Muso attacks Kagome. Inuyasha destroys him with his Wind Scar. Naraku, who was watching the event, tells Kagura to tell Inuyasha where Muso went.
Muso regenerates even thought he was hit with the Wind Scar. Miroku tells Inuyasha that Muso has a heart in the area where he has a spider marking.
Inuyasha visits Totosai in search of a technique that can break through Naraku's barrier. There he meets Bunza, a wildcat-demon child.
Myoga comes to deliver a message from Totosai.

programmes.st: The Red Tetsusaiga Breaks the Barrier!
programmes.d: The Hyakki Bat demon Otakemaru tries to destroy the village along with Shiori's mother.

programmes.st: The Plot of the Panther Devas
programmes.d: The Panther Tribe attacks from the west.
Jane and Rafael are still at odds about celebrating Mateo's first Christmas. Jane discovers the scholarship she thought she'd been awarded hasn't been.
Jane struggles to sleep train Mateo and the Villanueva woman are divided on what is the best method. She is also beginning her new job as a TA with basketball players looking for an easy A.
In the middle of the night, Jane gets a burst of creative energy and starts her thesis. Unfortunately, Mateo spills orange juice all over her computer causing it to lose all her hard work.
Jane's crush on Professor Chavez is popping up in her dreams and she needs to evaluate her feelings. Xo and Jane find Liliana's engagement ring and think that Rogelio is going to propose.
Jane is considering whether or not to take her relationship with Jonathan to the next level and turns to Xo for advice. Xo and Rogelio have their own relationship issues to work out.
Jane and Michael are back together, almost! Jane attempts to get Rafael and Michael to reconcile, but it doesn't go well. Rafael sulks over losing Jane and ignores Petra's pregnancy needs.
Jane and Michael are back together and Jane wishes she had never left Michael in the first place. Rafael appears to have regressed to his playboy ways and Petra is concerned about him.
Rafael and Petra are new parents but Petra is already back to work and appears to be not interested in motherhood. Xo has invited Alba's old flame Pablo to visit.
Jane and Michael's wedding plans are side tracked when the Villanueva house is ruined by a flood. Jane wants a small wedding, but Rogelio wants to throw Jane a big blow out wedding.
Jane has a specific idea of how she wants to celebrate her bachelorette party, but when Xo and Lina get involved, nothing goes as planned.
After Jane and Xo's fallout from Jane's bachelorette party, Jane now needs to someone to watch Mateo. When Michael volunteers to help everything is perfect until Mateo does something.
Jane takes on additional shifts at the Marbella to make extra money, but it cuts into her time with Mateo. Jane and Rafael agree to a formal custody agreement and decide to use a mediator.
The Villanueva women have a tradition for Mother's Day and Jane is excited to participate as a new mom. However, their plans are thwarted when Petra invites everyone to a brunch instead.
Jane has made big plans to celebrate Mateo's first birthday, but things start to fall apart when she learns there might be an issue with her wedding venue.
After moving up the wedding day, Jane and Michael find all their carefully made plans thrown into chaos. To make matters worse, Jane is unhappy with her current graduate thesis.

Jane discovers that Michael was shot and finds herself having to make difficult choices. With Rafael focused on keeping Mateo safe, Anezka, who is pretending to be Petra, "helps" the cops with their investigation.

When Rafael finally admits that he is over Jane, their co-parenting style is tested when they argue over what the best preschool is for Mateo. Xo is paranoid about Alba finding out her secret and what it will do to their relationship.
Donna says the defendants stored their old beat up RV on her property and they owe her money.
Allison says her baby daddy rarely sees their child, and is she suing for the cost of ballet classes and medical bills.
Lynn believes his wife was cheating on him throughout their relationship, now he's here to be paid back for a loan.
Paulita is suing her baby daddy for the value of a car, saying she left him because he's an abusive drunk.
McKenzie is suing her baby's father for the price of a car because he chooses work and football over the family.
Ashley is suing her former friend, Terra, for not returning her dog after caring for it while she was in rehab.
Mirtha is suing her ex-husband for stealing her car and leaving her to pay the bills after he up and left.
Keisha is suing her brother's girlfriend for the cost to fix her car after she damaged it during an altercation.
David is suing John after he was unable to get the car registered because he claims the title wasn't notarized.
Trudy is suing bar owner Jefferey for damages because she claims a drunk patron plowed into her parked car.
Anthony wants David to pay over $1300 in rent and belongings he claims David trashed.
Jane claims her ex-husband of 25 years owes her over $3,000 for their son's wedding.
Destiny is suing her Father for property damage after she claims he damaged the hood of her car.
Andrew is accusing his ex boss of assault and demands retribution for his back pain after the attack.
Rachel is suing her landlord because she claims he forced her to lose her job.
Kevin wants his ex-fiancé to pay him back for a loan he gave her to pay off her credit card.
Tyrone claims his ex wife Tania got him falsely arrested 3 times so he's here to sue her for $3,000.

It's an adventure of a lifetime when a baby tiger cub escapes from an animal sanctuary and follows a young boy home.

Dive into adventure with Sammy the sea turtle as he swims the ocean searching for the love of his life, Shelly. Based on the course of a sea turtle's life, this story of Sammy's breathtaking journey is a thrilling voyage the whole family will love!

programmes.t: A Turtle's Tale 2: Sammy's Escape From Paradise
programmes.d: When Sammy and Ray find themselves trapped in The Tank, an underwater aquarium, they must hatch a plan to escape and reunite with their grandkids, Ricky and Ella, and protect them from the dangers of the ocean.

Frankie the squirrel finds out acorns are being stolen by the evil A.C.O.R.N.S. Corporation. Now he must assemble a rag-tag team of forest animals with only three days to pull off their biggest heist.
A very unlucky leprechaun over comes great adventures.
While exploring their new kingdom, an adventurous Wee Dragon named Boil and his buddy Scazzle discover a way to enter the Upside Down Wee World, an alternate dimension that closely mirrors their own!
A 3D-animated movie set in Paris in the year 1910 and centered on a monster who lives in a garden and his love for a beautiful, young singer.

programmes.t: Monster Class: Krampus and Other Christmas Monsters
programmes.d: Join Monster Class teacher Count Dracula as he goes batty for cryptozoology, the study of monsters! In the world of cryptids — that's a fancy word for monsters — there is a group of monsters that haunt our favorite holiday, Christmas!

After Emma Wishbone drags her family to a costume party on Halloween night, they are all cursed by an evil witch and transformed into monsters. Now Emma must fight to keep her Monster Family together and uncover the secret of their curse…

When Lucas finds out he isn't really a human, but actually a monster, the news changes his whole world! Embarking on a quest to Monster Island to discover his real roots, Lucas will undergo a journey he will never forget.
Given one last chance to scare a typical human Family, these classic monsters don't stand a chance, until their “scared” Family steps in to help them. Fear mongering has never been so much fun!
As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers,Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.
The search for the Sandman leads Mateo and the others to the tallest mountain in the Dream World,but Lunia's hourglass puts a target on their backs.
A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob,who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.
Competing over who can ask Zoey to join their Sheep Week team,Logan cheats and unwittingly endangers the video game based Cyber Realm.
When the kids meddle in their teacher's dream to find test answers,they realize that in dreams,sweet little Ms. Putnam isn't so sweet… or little!
The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form.
A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud and is raising an army of lightning-infused Stone Monsters.

The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vehicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox.

Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounter the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick?
The Ninja search for Lloyd and walk right into Harumi's trap as Lloyd falls victim to her manipulation.
The Ninja search for escape while Master Wu and the others defend the Weapons of Spinjitzu from the Council of the Crystal King.
Nya, as Samurai X, rescues the Ninja, but Harumi's plan for the Weapons of Spinjitzu is already in motion.
Lloyd escapes from the Crystal Temple with the help of an unlikely ally, as both the Crystal King and the Ninja prepare for battle.
The Ninja retrieve the Destiny's Bounty and race to rescue Lloyd as he evades capture in the jungle below the Crystal Temple.
The Ninja fight back against the Crystal King's army as Lloyd and Master Wu trace a clue back to an unlikely ally.
Lloyd and Master Wu listen to Garmadon's recent journey of self-improvement and find the clue they need in the fight against the Crystal King.
Garmadon  trains  Lloyd  to  use  the  Oni  Form,  but  the  Ninja  resort  to  another  strategy  as  the  Crystal  King's  forces reach NINJAGO City.
The Ninja launch an assault through NINJAGO City in their upgraded vehicles, but the Crystal King unleashes a new source of power to stop them.
Master Wu takes shelter with an unlikely resistance while Nya and Jay escape the wreckage of the Destiny's Bounty with a plan to find help.
Pixal takes the broken Zane to Borg Tower for repairs with the help of unlikely allies, and Lloyd shows an old adversary what it means to be a hero.
Kai and Cole avoid capture and bring new hope to the resistance, while Lloyd and Garmadon search for the missing Serpentine.
The Ninja reach out to allies across NINJAGO, while at Borg Tower Pixal prepares for the coming battle
Racer Seven escorts Cole across NINJAGO City to send for help, and Lloyd gives Garmadon a chance to prove he has changed.

By order of the Phoenix, King Laval, Cragger, Eris and their friends must defend a mysterious hill against the Hunter Tribes. They discover that the hill is strangely immune to the Hunters’ Ice Powers.
When the Tribes of Chima, armed with ample Fire Chi, launch a furious counter-assault against the Hunters, Fangar and his cohorts disappear underground.

Our heroes continue pushing back the Hunters with their Fire Chi-powered vehicles, but when they search the sites of the Hunters’ attacks, they can’t find any of the defeated animals. What has happened to them?
Laval and Li’Ella’s relationship grows as he gives her a tour of the Lion City. But distracted, he misses a key battle against the Hunters. Tormak joins the fight and saves the day.
In his father’s absence, Laval forced to take over as King of the Lion Tribe, … a role that does not suit him well. The Hunters launch yet another major attack on the Lion City.
“Laval tries to mount a rescue to save the Kings and Li’Ella, but Flinx accidentally thaws out Fangars trophy room, and they end up having to fight both the Hunters, Scorpions, Spiders, and Bats.“
Desperate to save his daughter, Tormak betrays the Phoenix and steals the Map known as the Artifact. But the theft does not go as planned.
Logan's desperation to prove himself leads to his capture by the Nightmare King,which leaves his friends to face the Sheep Week finals alone.
The Dream Chasers rush to save Logan from the Shadowkeep's dungeon,but the liberators soon become the prisoners in a nightmarish twist of fate.
A mysterious dome blocks Mateo and the others from leaving their dream landing, and Zoey and Albert are their only hope of escape.
With Albert captured by the Night Hunter and Z-Blob detained by Agent Strick, it's time for a dual rescue in the Waking World and the Dream World!
Detective Izzie takes the case of Mateo's missing comic book while Nova, the head of the Insomniacs, probes into a mystery of her own.
The hunt for the Sandman, the only one who can repair Lunia's hourglass, brings the kids to the dangerous Murky Realm, where memories go to die!

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Race to the Top/Meet Harl Hubbs
programmes.d: Fendrich and Sinclair compete to win the City's tallest building contest. An off-screen narrator narrates a day in the life of a helpful handyman, Harl Hubbs.

programmes.st: LEGO City Adventures Doorman of the City/Fendrich In The Wild
programmes.d: It's "Hands Off Day!" a city holiday, where the entire city doesn't use their hands for anything. A nature documentary crew follows Billionaire Fendrich as if he was an animal in the wild.

Mister Rogers arrives with a children's plastic potty, takes it to his bathroom and compares it to the adult-sized toilet. Prince Tuesday comes up with a game using a bucket but has had his feelings hurt when his father was not impressed.

King Friday denounces the magic finder balloon. Neighbors Aber and Robert Troll are looking for Lady Elaine. They find her locked in a room of the Museum-Go-Round. At Mister Rogers' house, Levar Burton reads “The Daddy Book.”

Mister Rogers explains how a wheelchair lift works, and then shows one in action. He shows some of his puppets. Mayor Maggie and Neighbor Aber ride in a wheelchair until they have their checkups from Dr. Bill.

programmes.st: Field Trip to Visit Koko the Gorilla
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits with Koko the gorilla, who has learned how to communicate in sign language. In Make-Believe, there's a gorilla, too, who seems scary until the neighbors get to know him. And there's a video of how people make play balls.

programmes.st: An Eye Exam for Mister Rogers
programmes.d: At the eye doctor's office, Mister Rogers takes part in a general eye examination. The gorilla catches Lady Aberlin as she stumbles, which alarms Lady Elaine Fairchild. Lady Elaine is determined to catch the gorilla.

programmes.st: A Boy and His Service Dog
programmes.d: Mr. McFeely stops by with a film about a service dog aiding a handicapped child. Mister Rogers visits with the boy from the video and his dog. Lady Elaine Fairchile continues her efforts to catch the gorilla. Neighbor Aber is missing.
Mister Rogers reads a book about a dog named Zak. There's also a video visit to the Center for Creative Play, a place where children of all abilities can play.

Marilyn Barnett brings someone who has great talent with yo-yos. Mister Rogers shows a film of how people make wooden yo-yos. Prince Tuesday plays well with the yo-yo, but King Friday does not. Therefore, the king outlaws yo-yos.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Rides In a Helicopter
programmes.d: Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely ride with Maria Mancano on a helicopter. Miss Paulificate and Lady Aberlin have been assigned the duty of “yo-yo guard,” responsible for upholding the King's ban on yo-yos.

Mr. McFeely shows a photo album with pictures of Neighbors wearing different hats. Lady Aberlin informs King Friday that Lady Elaine's helicopter, Yo-Yo, is stuck in the air. King Friday commands that all references to yo-yos be removed.

programmes.st: Musician Yo-Yo Ma and Inventor Chuck Hoberman
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a video of inventor Chuck Hoberman with his sphere and a video of Yo-Yo and Nicholas Ma. The neighbors are waiting for Bob Dog's helicopter to land. They discover that the helicopter responds to guitar music.

Mister Rogers visits Maya Lin at her studio to see how she first makes small models of big things she is working on. They go to Penn Station to see what she created there. In Make-Believe, there's a video visit with cellist Yo-Yo Ma.

Mister Rogers sees a performance by the Westminster Bell Choir and shows how people make bells. Mayor Maggie has a bell that she plays with King Friday and gives to Henrietta as a doorbell. Daniel and H.J. Elephant dress up as astronauts.

Visiting a nearby dance studio, Mister Rogers watches a class of young students learning to use ribbons as part of their dance routine. Henrietta is still ringing her new bell and X the Owl is growing quite frustrated.

Percussionist Tim Adams performs. H.J. Elephant is dressed in his outerspace costume as he tells Lady Aberlin about pretending to fly to the moon. He makes a loud trumpet sound which causes alarm for X and Henrietta.

Mister Rogers shows a video of himself and Sylvia Earle snorkeling in the ocean. Lady Elaine says she is hiding from something they are afraid of from outer space. Mister Rogers suggests when something is scary on TV,  turn it off.

Neighbor Aber places a costume on top of Trolley to participate in the upcoming parade. Prince Tuesday is collecting comforting messages for X the Owl and Henrietta Pussycat in hopes of drawing them out for the parade.

Mister Rogers puts together a small fountain and shows a video of fountains around the world. King Friday gives a fountain to Westwood. Mayor Maggie searches for water for the fountain and is squirted by Lady Elaine Fairchilde.

Neighbor Aber wears a raincoat as Lady Elaine continues squirting water from her hose. He helps Corney install an umbrella over the factory. Mr. McFeely stops by with a videotape about how people make concrete sidewalks.

programmes.st: Visit to the Arthur TV Studio
programmes.d: Mister Rogers visits a television studio where the series Arthur is being animated. Mr. McFeely brings a video about how people make traffic signals. Arthur meets the puppets in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

Captain Arnold shows Mister Rogers various aspects of being a firefighter. Volunteer Firefighter Handyman Negri asks Lady Elaine for her garden hose. Smoke is seen coming from the Platypus mound. Lady Elaine puts out the fire.

programmes.st: What to Do During a Fire Drill
programmes.d: Fred Rogers visits a school and sees what the students do during a fire drill. Everyone is working to repair the Platypus Mound, which was damaged by a fire. Lady Elaine Fairchilde receives an award from King Friday XIII.
Mister Rogers demonstrates how to use a computer mouse as he introduces viewers to the "online neighborhood." The King and Queen are searching for the "royal mouse."

programmes.st: The Royal Hula Mouse Must Return
programmes.d: King Friday insists that the royal Hula Mouse must return to the Castle and asks Miss Paulificate to call "every person in the world."  King Friday is flying around the world searching for the royal mouse.

Mister Rogers watches demonstrations of mechanical ball inventions. Prince Tuesday and Lady Aberlin are outside the castle playing with a unique toy. King Friday is unhappy about not finding Hula Mouse and breaks the toy.
Not everyone in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe has recovered from the previous day's drama. King Friday tries to apologize. Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make bread.

Mister Rogers watches children dancers perform and musicians play. King Friday sincerely apologizes to Hula Mouse for his previous behavior. Lady Elaine presents an exhibit of round things. Mr. McFeely shows a film on how marbles are made.

The squad tries to find a newly released prisoner who has missed two parole meetings. Therapist Dr. Joe Bowman (BILL BROCHTRUP) evaluates Rusty over a game of chess.
When a body turns up at a posh country club, the squad's investigation leads them down a money trail full of surprises. DDA Rios' actions have Rusty questioning her intentions.
Christmas vacation is interrupted when a baseball scout is found dead, and a complicated kidnapping scheme unfolds. Rusty opens up to Dr. Joe (BILL BROCHTRUP) about his mom.
Major Crimes works with the FBI, including Fritz Howard (JON TENNEY), on a case. It is revealed how each member of the unit became interested in joining the police force.
The squad investigates a bomb explosion. Rusty dons a bulletproof vest in an attempt to catch the person responsible for threatening him. MALCOLM-JAMAL WARNER guest stars.
The squad must work quickly to track down a serial killer before he strikes again. Things get dangerous over a game of chess. MALCOLM-JAMAL WARNER appears as Lt. Chuck Cooper.
Season finale: The squad draws closer to finding a dangerous serial killer. Rusty faces his biggest challenge as he takes the stand against Stroh. JERI RYAN, JON TENNEY guest star.

A murder victim's case is reopened and the squad works hard to solve a 17-year-old murder. EVER CARRADINE guest stars as Rusty's mother, Sharon Beck.
The team works to solve the murder of a dog that was left a $20 million estate by its deceased owner, with the help of a wannabe detective (ANDREW DALY - The Closer).
The violent murder of an alleged rapist gives the squad the emotional task of questioning suspects. Rusty catches his mom (EVER CARRADINE) in a lie and questions her motives.
The members of NCIS are distressed when Gibbs is injured in a terrorist explosion while on assignment.

As the team tries to track down the terrorists behind the bombing that injured Gibbs, they learn that the terrorist group is planning another bombing of 9-11 magnitude--and that Gibbs has information about their plan.

As each team member deals with the absence of a retired Gibbs, Ziva's past comes back to haunt her when she inadvertently witnesses the assassination of a military attaché by her former Mossad partner.

Doug and Carrie pick up some of their photos, but soon they find out, it's not their photos, but photos of another couple.
Doug doesn't want to go to the opera.
Al gets a first-hand look at swinging bachelor life when he takes refuge at Luke's apartment after an argument with Peggy over visiting her relatives for the weekend.
To get the money to purchase a new VCR that Al won't buy her, Peggy takes a job in a department store selling clocks.
When Al and Peg decide to go on vacation, Steve and Marcy volunteer to take care of their kids, Bud and Kelly. But, their enthusiasm changes when the kids throw a huge party at the Rhoades' house.

Al invites Steve to play poker with his friends but ends up losing his paycheck to Al.  Avoiding telling the truth to Marcy fails as Al plans to use his winnings to buy a fishing rod.  Ultimately, Marcy enlists the help of Peggy to stop him.

Becker arrives at the office carrying the parking meter that ate his quarter.
Becker's patient, Jimmy, is a penniless scalper who is unable to afford his ulcer treatment.
On Jake's way out to meet his girlfriend, Becker warns him that his zipper is down.

programmes.st: HIS NAME IS MORIA! THE GREAT SHADOW-SEIZING PIRATE'S TRAP
programmes.d: Luffy sets his sights on the shadowing-stealing monster known as Gecko Moria, and the zombie army prepares for a night attack led by their perverted, invisible leader!

programmes.st: A BUNCH OF ANIMALS? PERONA'S WONDER GARDEN
